theorem FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.rel {L : FirstOrder.Language} [FiniteRelational L]
    {N : FiniteRelModel L V} (h : N.IsIndivisibleFor P) {m : ℕ} (S : L.Relations m) :
    IsIndivisible P (N.Holds S)
proof:
:=
  h m S

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIndivisible.const_on_cells
proof:
:=
  h x y (fun i ↦ P.le (hC i) (hx i)) (fun i ↦ P.le (hC i) (hy i))
    fun i ↦ (P.part_eq_of_mem (hC i) (hx i)).trans (P.part_eq_of_mem (hC i) (hy i)).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIndivisible.const_on_cellBox
proof:
:=
  h.const_on_cells hC (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hx) (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hy)

name: RegularityLemmata.part_eq_of_mem_cells
statement:
theorem part_eq_of_mem_cells {C : Fin n → P.parts} {x : Fin n → V}
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ (C i : Finset V)) (i : Fin n) : P.part (x i) = (C i : Finset V)
proof:
:=
  P.part_eq_of_mem (C i).2 (hx i)

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIndivisible.quotientRel_iff
statement:
theorem IsIndivisible.quotientRel_iff (h : IsIndivisible P R) (C : Fin n → P.parts)
    {x : Fin n → V} (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ (C i : Finset V)) : quotientRel P R C ↔ R x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hRy⟩
    exact (h.const_on_cells (fun i ↦ (C i).2) hy hx).mp hRy
  · exact fun hR ↦ ⟨x, hx, hR⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIndivisible.quotientRel_part
proof:
:=
  h.quotientRel_iff _ fun i ↦ P.mem_part (hx i)

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIndivisible.quotientRel_iff_forall
statement:
theorem IsIndivisible.quotientRel_iff_forall (h : IsIndivisible P R) (C : Fin n → P.parts) :
    quotientRel P R C ↔ ∀ x : Fin n → V, (∀ i, x i ∈ (C i : Finset V)) → R x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hq x hx ↦ (h.quotientRel_iff C hx).mp hq, fun hall ↦ ?_⟩
  choose x hx using fun i ↦ P.nonempty_of_mem_parts (C i).2
  exact ⟨x, hx, hall x hx⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIndivisible.mono_of_le
statement: theorem IsIndivisible.mono_of_le (h : IsIndivisible P R) (hQP : Q ≤ P) : IsIndivisible Q R
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hpart
  refine h x y hx hy fun i ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hsub⟩ := hQP (Q.part_mem.mpr (hx i))
  have hyi : y i ∈ Q.part (x i) := by rw [hpart i]; exact Q.mem_part (hy i)
  exact (P.part_eq_of_mem hA (hsub (Q.mem_part (hx i)))).trans
    (P.part_eq_of_mem hA (hsub hyi)).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.mono_of_le
statement:
theorem FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.mono_of_le {L : FirstOrder.Language} [FiniteRelational L]
    {N : FiniteRelModel L V} (h : N.IsIndivisibleFor P) (hQP : Q ≤ P) : N.IsIndivisibleFor Q
proof:
:=
  fun m S ↦ (h m S).mono_of_le hQP

name: RegularityLemmata.disjoint_piFinset_of_ne
statement:
theorem disjoint_piFinset_of_ne {C D : Fin n → Finset V} (hC : ∀ i, C i ∈ P.parts)
    (hD : ∀ i, D i ∈ P.parts) (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    Disjoint (Fintype.piFinset C) (Fintype.piFinset D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, C i ≠ D i := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    exact hCD (funext hcon)
  refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxC hxD ↦ ?_
  rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hxC hxD
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (P.disjoint (hC i) (hD i) hi) (hxC i) (hxD i)

name: RegularityLemmata.piFinset_const_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem piFinset_const_eq_biUnion (P : Finpartition s) (n : ℕ) :
    (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)
      = (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin n ↦ P.parts).biUnion fun C ↦ Fintype.piFinset C
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ⟨fun i ↦ P.part (x i), fun i ↦ P.part_mem.mpr (hx i),
    fun i ↦ P.mem_part (hx i)⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨C, hC, hx⟩
  exact fun i ↦ P.le (hC i) (hx i)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_piFinset_const
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_const (P : Finpartition s) (n : ℕ) :
    (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin n ↦ s).card
      = ∑ C ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin n ↦ P.parts, (Fintype.piFinset C).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [piFinset_const_eq_biUnion P n]
  refine Finset.card_biUnion fun C hC D hD hCD ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hC hD
  exact disjoint_piFinset_of_ne hC hD hCD

name: RegularityLemmata.isIndivisible_of_arity_zero
statement:
theorem isIndivisible_of_arity_zero (P : Finpartition s) (R : (Fin 0 → V) → Prop) :
    IsIndivisible P R
proof:
:= fun x y _ _ _ ↦ by
  rw [show x = y from funext fun i ↦ i.elim0]

name: RegularityLemmata.isIndivisible_of_empty
statement:
theorem isIndivisible_of_empty (P : Finpartition (∅ : Finset V)) (R : (Fin n → V) → Prop) :
    IsIndivisible P R
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact isIndivisible_of_arity_zero P R
  | succ m => exact fun _ _ hx _ _ ↦ absurd (hx 0) (by simp)

name: RegularityLemmata.isIndivisible_bot
statement: theorem isIndivisible_bot (R : (Fin n → V) → Prop) : IsIndivisible (⊥ : Finpartition s) R
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hpart
  have hpt : ∀ a ∈ s, (⊥ : Finpartition s).part a = {a} := fun a ha ↦
    Finpartition.part_eq_of_mem _ (Finpartition.mem_bot_iff.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
      (Finset.mem_singleton_self a)
  refine iff_of_eq (congrArg R (funext fun i ↦ ?_))
  exact Finset.singleton_injective
    ((hpt (x i) (hx i)).symm.trans ((hpart i).trans (hpt (y i) (hy i))))

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.isIndivisibleFor_iff_pos
statement:
theorem FiniteRelModel.isIndivisibleFor_iff_pos {L : FirstOrder.Language} [FiniteRelational L]
    (N : FiniteRelModel L V) (P : Finpartition s) :
    N.IsIndivisibleFor P ↔ ∀ m, 0 < m → ∀ S : L.Relations m, IsIndivisible P (N.Holds S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h m _ S ↦ h m S, fun h m S ↦ ?_⟩
  cases m with
  | zero => exact isIndivisible_of_arity_zero P _
  | succ k => exact h _ k.succ_pos S

name: RegularityLemmata.quotientRel_zero
statement:
theorem quotientRel_zero {L : FirstOrder.Language} [FiniteRelational L] (N : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (P : Finpartition s) (S : L.Relations 0) (C : Fin 0 → P.parts) :
    quotientRel P (N.Holds S) C ↔ N.Holds S Fin.elim0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ⟨Fin.elim0, fun i ↦ i.elim0, h⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨x, -, hR⟩
  rwa [show x = Fin.elim0 from funext fun i ↦ i.elim0] at hR

name: RegularityLemmata.nullaryCompatible_iff_quotientRel
statement:
theorem nullaryCompatible_iff_quotientRel {L : FirstOrder.Language} [FiniteRelational L]
    {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] {t : Finset W} (M : FiniteRelModel L W)
    (N : FiniteRelModel L V) (Q' : Finpartition t) (P : Finpartition s) :
    NullaryCompatible M N ↔ ∀ S : L.Relations 0, ∀ (C : Fin 0 → Q'.parts) (D : Fin 0 → P.parts),
      (quotientRel Q' (M.Holds S) C ↔ quotientRel P (N.Holds S) D)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h S C D ↦ ?_, fun h S ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [quotientRel_zero, quotientRel_zero]
    exact h S
  · have := h S (fun i ↦ i.elim0) fun i ↦ i.elim0
    rwa [quotientRel_zero, quotientRel_zero] at this

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.quotient_holds_iff
proof:
:= by
  show decide _ = true ↔ _
  rw [decide_eq_true_iff, quotientRel]
  simp only [Fintype.mem_piFinset]

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.quotient_holds_iff
statement:
theorem FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.quotient_holds_iff {N : FiniteRelModel L V}
    (h : N.IsIndivisibleFor Q) {n : ℕ} (S : L.Relations n) (C : Fin n → Q.parts)
    {x : Fin n → V} (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ (C i : Finset V)) :
    (N.quotient Q).Holds S C ↔ N.Holds S x
proof:
:=
  (N.quotient_holds_iff Q S C).trans ((h.rel S).quotientRel_iff C hx)

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.quotient_holds_part
proof:
:=
  (N.quotient_holds_iff Q S _).trans ((h.rel S).quotientRel_part hx)

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.quotient_holds_zero
statement:
theorem FiniteRelModel.quotient_holds_zero (N : FiniteRelModel L V) (Q : Finpartition s)
    (S : L.Relations 0) (C : Fin 0 → Q.parts) :
    (N.quotient Q).Holds S C ↔ N.Holds S Fin.elim0
proof:
:=
  (N.quotient_holds_iff Q S C).trans (quotientRel_zero N Q S C)

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.nullaryCompatible_quotient
statement:
theorem FiniteRelModel.nullaryCompatible_quotient (N : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (Q : Finpartition s) : NullaryCompatible N (N.quotient Q)
proof:
:=
  fun S ↦ (N.quotient_holds_zero Q S Fin.elim0).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.IsIndivisibleFor.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_cells
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [inducedEmbeddingCountOn]
  have hkey : ∀ f ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ (C i : Finset V)),
      (Function.Injective f ∧ PreservesAndReflects P N f)
        ↔ PreservesAndReflects P (N.quotient Q) C := by
    intro f hf
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hf
    have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro i j hij
      apply hC
      apply Subtype.ext
      by_contra hne
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp
        (Q.disjoint (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (C i).2) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (C j).2) hne)
        (hf i) (hij ▸ hf j)
    refine ⟨fun hp S x ↦ ?_, fun hp ↦ ⟨hinj, fun S x ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h.quotient_holds_iff S.2 (C ∘ x) (x := f ∘ x) fun i ↦ hf (x i)]
      exact hp.2 S x
    · rw [← h.quotient_holds_iff S.2 (C ∘ x) (x := f ∘ x) fun i ↦ hf (x i)]
      exact hp S x
  split_ifs with hpar
  · rw [Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun f hf ↦ (hkey f hf).mpr hpar, Fintype.card_piFinset]
  · rw [Finset.filter_false_of_mem fun f hf hp ↦ hpar ((hkey f hf).mp hp), Finset.card_empty]

name: RegularityLemmata.quotientInducedCount_eq_sum_ite
statement:
theorem quotientInducedCount_eq_sum_ite {N : FiniteRelModel L V} (h : N.IsIndivisibleFor Q)
    (P : FiniteRelModel L W) :
    quotientInducedCount P N Q
      = ∑ C ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (W → Q.parts)).filter Function.Injective,
          inducedEmbeddingCountOn P N (fun i ↦ (C i : Finset V))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [quotientInducedCount, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun C _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hC : Function.Injective C
  · rw [ite_eq_left hC, h.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_cells P hC]
    by_cases hp : FiniteRelModel.PreservesAndReflects P (N.quotient Q) C
    · rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hC, hp⟩, ite_eq_left hp]
    · rw [ite_eq_right fun h' ↦ hp h'.2, ite_eq_right hp]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hC, ite_eq_right fun h' ↦ hC h'.1]

name: RegularityLemmata.parityModel_isIndivisibleFor
statement: private theorem parityModel_isIndivisibleFor : parityModel.IsIndivisibleFor parityPart
proof:
:= by
  intro n R
  match n with
  | 2 =>
    intro x y hx hy hp
    have key := (by decide : IsIndivisible parityPart
      (fun x : Fin 2 → Fin 4 ↦ (x 0 : ℕ) % 2 = (x 1 : ℕ) % 2)) x y hx hy hp
    simpa [FiniteRelModel.Holds, parityModel] using key
  | 0 | 1 | _ + 3 => exact R.elim

name: RegularityLemmata.transversalInducedCount_le_globalInducedCount
statement:
theorem transversalInducedCount_le_globalInducedCount :
    transversalInducedCount P N Q ≤ globalInducedCount P N Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [globalInducedCount_eq_transversal_add_nontransversal]
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.isTransversalizable_iff
statement:
theorem isTransversalizable_iff :
    IsTransversalizable N Q ↔
      ∀ P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3),
        (0 < globalInducedCount P N Q ↔ 0 < transversalInducedCount P N Q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h P
    exact ⟨h P, fun hT => lt_of_lt_of_le hT transversalInducedCount_le_globalInducedCount⟩
  · intro h P hP
    exact (h P).mp hP

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_transversal_of_isTransversalizable
statement:
theorem exists_transversal_of_isTransversalizable (h : IsTransversalizable N Q)
    (hP : 0 < globalInducedCount P N Q) :
    ∃ T ∈ transversalCellTriples Q, 0 < inducedEmbeddingCountOn P N T
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := h P hP
  rw [transversalInducedCount] at hpos
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have : ∑ T ∈ transversalCellTriples Q, inducedEmbeddingCountOn P N T = 0 :=
    Finset.sum_eq_zero fun T hT => Nat.le_zero.mp (hcon T hT)
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.transversalCellTriples_eq_empty_of_card_lt_three
statement:
theorem transversalCellTriples_eq_empty_of_card_lt_three (Q : Finpartition s)
    (h : Q.parts.card < 3) : transversalCellTriples Q = (∅ : Finset (Fin 3 → Finset V))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro T hT
  obtain ⟨hmem, hinj⟩ := mem_transversalCellTriples.mp hT
  have hcard : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≤ Q.parts.card :=
    Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn T (fun i _ => hmem i) (Function.Injective.injOn hinj)
  rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.globalInducedCount_eq_zero_of_card_lt_three
statement:
theorem globalInducedCount_eq_zero_of_card_lt_three (h : IsTransversalizable N Q)
    (hcard : Q.parts.card < 3) (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)) :
    globalInducedCount P N Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  have hpos : 0 < globalInducedCount P N Q := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcon
  have := h P hpos
  rw [transversalInducedCount, transversalCellTriples_eq_empty_of_card_lt_three Q hcard,
    Finset.sum_empty] at this
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.three_le_card_parts_of_isTransversalizable
statement:
theorem three_le_card_parts_of_isTransversalizable (h : IsTransversalizable N Q)
    (hP : 0 < globalInducedCount P N Q) : 3 ≤ Q.parts.card
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcard
  have ht := h P hP
  rw [transversalInducedCount,
    transversalCellTriples_eq_empty_of_card_lt_three Q (by omega),
    Finset.sum_empty] at ht
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_eq_zero_of_repeat_of_card_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedEmbeddingCountOn, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
  intro f hf hcon
  rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hf
  have h1 : f i ∈ T i := hf i
  have h2 : f j ∈ T i := hT ▸ hf j
  exact hij (hcon.1 (Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard _ h1 _ h2))

name: RegularityLemmata.isTransversalizable_of_forall_card_le_one
statement:
theorem isTransversalizable_of_forall_card_le_one (N : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (Q : Finpartition s) (hQ : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ 1) : IsTransversalizable N Q
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  rw [globalInducedCount_eq_transversal_add_nontransversal] at hP
  have hzero : ∑ T ∈ nontransversalCellTriples Q, inducedEmbeddingCountOn P N T = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun T hT => ?_
    rw [nontransversalCellTriples, Finset.mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hT
    obtain ⟨hmem, hninj⟩ := hT
    rw [Function.not_injective_iff] at hninj
    obtain ⟨i, j, hEq, hne⟩ := hninj
    exact inducedEmbeddingCountOn_eq_zero_of_repeat_of_card_le_one hne hEq (hQ _ (hmem i))
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_le_iff
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_le_iff {c : ℝ} :
    rectCutNorm f wX wY A B ≤ c ↔ ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ B, |rectSum f wX wY S T| ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectCutNorm, Finset.sup'_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h S hS T hT
    exact h (S, T) (Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hS, Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hT⟩)
  · rintro h ⟨S, T⟩ hp
    rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powerset, Finset.mem_powerset] at hp
    exact h S hp.1 T hp.2

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm
statement:
theorem abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    |rectSum f wX wY S T| ≤ rectCutNorm f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  rectCutNorm_le_iff.mp le_rfl S hS T hT

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem rectCutNorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ rectCutNorm f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  le_trans (abs_nonneg _)
    (abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm (Finset.empty_subset A) (Finset.empty_subset B))

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_op
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_op (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X)
    (B : Finset Y) : rectCutNorm f.op wY wX B A = rectCutNorm f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [rectCutNorm_le_iff]
    intro T hT S hS
    rw [rectSum_op]
    exact abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm hS hT
  · rw [rectCutNorm_le_iff]
    intro S hS T hT
    rw [← rectSum_op]
    exact abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm hT hS

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_smul_weight_left {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectCutNorm f (fun x => c * wX x) wY A B = c * rectCutNorm f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [rectCutNorm_le_iff]
    intro S hS T hT
    rw [rectSum_smul_weight_left, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm hS hT) hc.le
  · rw [← le_div_iff₀' hc, rectCutNorm_le_iff]
    intro S hS T hT
    have h := abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm (f := f) (wX := fun x => c * wX x) (wY := wY) hS hT
    rw [rectSum_smul_weight_left, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc] at h
    rwa [le_div_iff₀' hc]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_le_mul_mass
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_le_mul_mass {C : ℝ} (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hf : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f C A B) :
    rectCutNorm f wX wY A B ≤ C * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectCutNorm_le_iff]
  intro S hS T hT
  have hwS : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ wX x := fun x hx => hwX x (hS hx)
  have hwT : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ wY y := fun y hy => hwY y (hT hy)
  refine (abs_rectSum_le hwS hwT fun x hx y hy => hf x (hS hx) y (hT hy)).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC
  exact mul_le_mul (finsetMass_mono hwX hS) (finsetMass_mono hwY hT)
    (finsetMass_nonneg hwT) (finsetMass_nonneg hwX)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) (h : finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B = 0) :
    rectCutNorm f wX wY A B = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ rectCutNorm_nonneg
  rw [rectCutNorm_le_iff]
  intro S hS T hT
  rw [rectSum_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero hwX hwY hS hT h, abs_zero]

name: RegularityLemmata.traceFamily_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem traceFamily_empty_left (s : Finset α) :
    traceFamily (∅ : Finset (Finset α)) s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceFamily]

name: RegularityLemmata.traceFamily_empty_right
statement:
theorem traceFamily_empty_right {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} (h𝒜 : 𝒜.Nonempty) :
    traceFamily 𝒜 ∅ = {∅}
proof:
:= by
  simpa [traceFamily] using (Finset.image_const h𝒜 (∅ : Finset α))

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_traceFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_traceFamily {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s t : Finset α} :
    t ∈ traceFamily 𝒜 s ↔ ∃ u ∈ 𝒜, s ∩ u = t
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceFamily]

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_traceFamily_subset
statement:
theorem mem_traceFamily_subset {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s t : Finset α}
    (ht : t ∈ traceFamily 𝒜 s) : t ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := mem_traceFamily.1 ht
  exact Finset.inter_subset_left

name: RegularityLemmata.traceFamily_mono_left
statement:
theorem traceFamily_mono_left {𝒜 ℬ : Finset (Finset α)} (h𝒜ℬ : 𝒜 ⊆ ℬ)
    (s : Finset α) : traceFamily 𝒜 s ⊆ traceFamily ℬ s
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := mem_traceFamily.1 ht
  exact mem_traceFamily.2 ⟨u, h𝒜ℬ hu, rfl⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.traceFamily_eq_self_of_subset
statement:
theorem traceFamily_eq_self_of_subset {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s : Finset α}
    (h𝒜 : ∀ t ∈ 𝒜, t ⊆ s) : traceFamily 𝒜 s = 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := mem_traceFamily.1 ht
    simpa [Finset.inter_eq_right.2 (h𝒜 u hu)] using hu
  · intro t ht
    exact mem_traceFamily.2 ⟨t, ht, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 (h𝒜 t ht)⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.traceFamily_traceFamily
statement:
theorem traceFamily_traceFamily (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s t : Finset α) :
    traceFamily (traceFamily 𝒜 s) t = traceFamily 𝒜 (t ∩ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [traceFamily, Finset.image_image]
  apply Finset.image_congr
  intro u _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [Finset.inter_assoc]

name: RegularityLemmata.traceFamily_eq_powerset_iff
statement:
theorem traceFamily_eq_powerset_iff {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s : Finset α} :
    traceFamily 𝒜 s = s.powerset ↔ 𝒜.Shatters s
proof:
:= by
  simpa [traceFamily] using (Finset.shatters_iff (𝒜 := 𝒜) (s := s)).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.vcDim_traceFamily_le
statement:
theorem vcDim_traceFamily_le (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s : Finset α) :
    (traceFamily 𝒜 s).vcDim ≤ 𝒜.vcDim
proof:
:= by
  unfold Finset.vcDim
  apply Finset.sup_mono
  intro t ht
  rw [Finset.mem_shatterer] at ht ⊢
  have hts : t ⊆ s := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, htu⟩ := ht.exists_superset
    exact htu.trans (mem_traceFamily_subset hu)
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := ht hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, huw⟩ := mem_traceFamily.1 hu
  refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
  rw [← huv, ← huw]
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_inter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxt, hxw⟩
    exact ⟨hxt, hts hxt, hxw⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxt, _, hxw⟩
    exact ⟨hxt, hxw⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.vcDim_image_inter_le
statement:
theorem vcDim_image_inter_le (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s : Finset α) :
    (𝒜.image fun t => s ∩ t).vcDim ≤ 𝒜.vcDim
proof:
:=
  vcDim_traceFamily_le 𝒜 s

name: RegularityLemmata.card_powerset_filter_card_le_sum_choose
statement:
theorem card_powerset_filter_card_le_sum_choose (s : Finset α) (d : ℕ) :
    #(s.powerset.filter fun t => t.card ≤ d) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, s.card.choose k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    #(s.powerset.filter fun t => t.card ≤ d) ≤
        #((Finset.Iic d).biUnion fun k => s.powersetCard k) := by
      apply Finset.card_mono
      intro t ht
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ht
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨t.card, Finset.mem_Iic.2 ht.2,
        Finset.mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.1 ht.1, rfl⟩⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, #(s.powersetCard k) := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, s.card.choose k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      exact Finset.card_powersetCard k s

name: RegularityLemmata.card_setFamily_le_sum_choose_of_subset
statement:
theorem card_setFamily_le_sum_choose_of_subset (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s : Finset α)
    (h𝒜 : ∀ t ∈ 𝒜, t ⊆ s) :
    #𝒜 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, s.card.choose k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    #𝒜 ≤ #𝒜.shatterer := Finset.card_le_card_shatterer 𝒜
    _ ≤ #((Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim).biUnion (fun k => s.powersetCard k)) := by
      apply Finset.card_mono
      intro t ht
      rw [Finset.mem_shatterer] at ht
      have hts : t ⊆ s := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu, htu⟩ := ht.exists_superset
        exact htu.trans (h𝒜 u hu)
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨t.card, Finset.mem_Iic.2 ht.card_le_vcDim,
        Finset.mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨hts, rfl⟩⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, #(s.powersetCard k) := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, s.card.choose k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      exact Finset.card_powersetCard k s

name: RegularityLemmata.card_traceFamily_le_sum_choose
statement:
theorem card_traceFamily_le_sum_choose (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s : Finset α) :
    #(traceFamily 𝒜 s) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, s.card.choose k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    #(traceFamily 𝒜 s) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic (traceFamily 𝒜 s).vcDim, s.card.choose k :=
      card_setFamily_le_sum_choose_of_subset _ _ fun _ ht => mem_traceFamily_subset ht
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, s.card.choose k := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset
        (Finset.Iic_subset_Iic.2 (vcDim_traceFamily_le 𝒜 s))

name: RegularityLemmata.card_image_inter_le_sum_choose
statement:
theorem card_image_inter_le_sum_choose (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s : Finset α) :
    #(𝒜.image fun t => s ∩ t) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, s.card.choose k
proof:
:=
  card_traceFamily_le_sum_choose 𝒜 s

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_choose_le_pow
statement:
theorem sum_choose_le_pow (n d : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k) ≤ (n + 1) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.range_succ_eq_Iic, add_pow]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k hk
  have hkd : k ≤ d := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  calc
    n.choose k ≤ n ^ k := Nat.choose_le_pow n k
    _ ≤ n ^ k * 1 ^ (d - k) * d.choose k := by
      simp only [one_pow, mul_one]
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (n ^ k) (Nat.choose_pos hkd)

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_choose_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem sum_choose_le_two_pow (n d : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k) ≤ 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.sum_range_choose n]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_ne_zero
  intro k _ hk
  rw [Finset.mem_range]
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_lt fun h => hk (Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt h))

name: RegularityLemmata.card_traceFamily_le_pow
statement:
theorem card_traceFamily_le_pow (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s : Finset α) :
    #(traceFamily 𝒜 s) ≤ 2 ^ s.card
proof:
:=
  (card_traceFamily_le_sum_choose 𝒜 s).trans (sum_choose_le_two_pow s.card 𝒜.vcDim)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_fiberFamily_le_sum_choose
statement:
theorem card_fiberFamily_le_sum_choose (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    #(fiberFamily R A B) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic (fiberFamily R A B).vcDim, B.card.choose k
proof:
:=
  card_setFamily_le_sum_choose_of_subset _ _ fun _ ht => mem_fiberFamily_subset R A B ht

name: RegularityLemmata.card_fiberFamily_le_pow
statement:
theorem card_fiberFamily_le_pow (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    #(fiberFamily R A B) ≤ 2 ^ B.card
proof:
:=
  (card_fiberFamily_le_sum_choose R A B).trans
    (sum_choose_le_two_pow B.card (fiberFamily R A B).vcDim)

name: RegularityLemmata.badNbhd_subset
statement:
theorem badNbhd_subset {B : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel B] {S : Finset V} {v : V} :
    badNbhd B S v ⊆ S
proof:
:=
  Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: RegularityLemmata.badNbhd_mono
statement:
theorem badNbhd_mono {B : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel B] {S S' : Finset V}
    (h : S' ⊆ S) (v : V) : badNbhd B S' v ⊆ badNbhd B S v
proof:
:=
  Finset.filter_subset_filter _ h

name: RegularityLemmata.not_bad_of_mem_of_notMem_badNbhd
statement:
theorem not_bad_of_mem_of_notMem_badNbhd {B : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel B]
    {S : Finset V} {v u : V} (hu : u ∈ S) (h : u ∉ badNbhd B S v) :
    ¬ B v u ∧ ¬ B u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [badNbhd, Finset.mem_filter] at h
  push Not at h
  exact h hu

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_clean_subset_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem exists_clean_subset_of_degree_le (B : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel B]
    (D : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, S.card ≤ (D + 1) * T.card ∧
      ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, x ≠ y → ¬ B x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with
  | _ S ih =>
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨v, hv⟩
    · exact ⟨∅, subset_rfl, by simp, by simp⟩
    have hstrict : S \ insert v (badNbhd B S v) ⊂ S :=
      Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset Finset.sdiff_subset |>.mpr
        ⟨v, hv, fun hmem =>
          (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hmem).2 (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)⟩
    obtain ⟨T', hT'sub, hT'card, hT'clean⟩ :=
      ih _ hstrict (fun u hu =>
        le_trans
          (Finset.card_le_card
            (badNbhd_mono Finset.sdiff_subset u))
          (hdeg u (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hu).1))
    have hvT' : v ∉ T' := fun hmem =>
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hT'sub hmem)).2 (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    refine ⟨insert v T', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.insert_subset hv (hT'sub.trans Finset.sdiff_subset)
    · have h1 : S.card ≤ (S \ insert v (badNbhd B S v)).card
          + (insert v (badNbhd B S v)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card_sdiff_add_card
      have h2 : (insert v (badNbhd B S v)).card ≤ D + 1 :=
        le_trans (Finset.card_insert_le _ _)
          (Nat.add_le_add_right (hdeg v hv) 1)
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hvT']
      calc S.card ≤ (S \ insert v (badNbhd B S v)).card + (D + 1) := by omega
        _ ≤ (D + 1) * T'.card + (D + 1) := by omega
        _ = (D + 1) * (T'.card + 1) := by ring
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
        · exact absurd rfl hxy
        · have hyS := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hT'sub hy')
          exact (not_bad_of_mem_of_notMem_badNbhd hyS.1 fun hbad =>
            hyS.2 (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hbad)).1
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
        · have hxS := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hT'sub hx')
          exact (not_bad_of_mem_of_notMem_badNbhd hxS.1 fun hbad =>
            hxS.2 (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hbad)).2
        · exact hT'clean x hx' y hy' hxy

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_degree_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_degree_le (B : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel B] (S : Finset V)
    {E D : ℕ} (hE : ∑ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ E)
    (hD : 2 * E ≤ S.card * (D + 1)) :
    S.card ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun v => (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit : (S.filter (fun v => (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card
      + (S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card = S.card :=
    Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (fun v => (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)
  have h1 : (S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card * (D + 1)
      ≤ ∑ v ∈ S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D),
          (badNbhd B S v).card := by
    calc (S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card * (D + 1)
        = ∑ _v ∈ S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D), (D + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id]
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D),
            (badNbhd B S v).card :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun v hv => by
            have h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
            omega
  have h2 : ∑ v ∈ S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D),
        (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ ∑ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have h3 : 2 * (S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card * (D + 1)
      ≤ S.card * (D + 1) := by
    calc 2 * (S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card * (D + 1)
        = 2 * ((S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card * (D + 1)) :=
          by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * E := by omega
      _ ≤ S.card * (D + 1) := hD
  have h4 : 2 * (S.filter (fun v => ¬ (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card ≤ S.card :=
    Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 (Nat.succ_pos D)
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_clean_subset
statement:
theorem exists_clean_subset (B : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel B] (S : Finset V)
    {E D : ℕ} (hE : ∑ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ E)
    (hD : 2 * E ≤ S.card * (D + 1)) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, S.card ≤ 2 * (D + 1) * T.card ∧
      ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, x ≠ y → ¬ B x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h0 := card_filter_degree_le B S hE hD
  obtain ⟨T, hTsub, hTcard, hTclean⟩ :=
    exists_clean_subset_of_degree_le B D
      (S.filter (fun v => (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D))
      (fun v hv =>
        le_trans
          (Finset.card_le_card (badNbhd_mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) v))
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2)
  refine ⟨T, hTsub.trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _), ?_, hTclean⟩
  calc S.card ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun v => (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card := h0
    _ ≤ 2 * ((D + 1) * T.card) := by omega
    _ = 2 * (D + 1) * T.card := by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.card_product_inter_eq_sum_right
statement:
theorem card_product_inter_eq_sum_right (E : Finset (X × Y)) (U : Finset X) (V : Finset Y) :
    ((U ×ˢ V) ∩ E).card = ∑ y ∈ V, (U.filter fun x ↦ (x, y) ∈ E).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_product_right]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ ↦ (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.card_product_inter_eq_sum_left
statement:
theorem card_product_inter_eq_sum_left (E : Finset (X × Y)) (U : Finset X) (V : Finset Y) :
    ((U ×ˢ V) ∩ E).card = ∑ x ∈ U, (V.filter fun y ↦ (x, y) ∈ E).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_averageOn_comm
statement:
theorem averageOn_averageOn_comm (g : X → Y → ℝ) (U : Finset X) (V : Finset Y) :
    averageOn U (fun x ↦ averageOn V (g x)) = averageOn V (fun y ↦ averageOn U (g · y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rectAverageCount_eq_averageOn_left g U V, rectAverageCount_eq_averageOn_right]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_averageOn_indicator_mul
statement:
theorem averageOn_averageOn_indicator_mul (E : Finset (X × Y)) (U : Finset X)
    (V : Finset Y) :
    averageOn U (fun x ↦ averageOn V fun y ↦ if (x, y) ∈ E then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      * ((U.card : ℝ) * (V.card : ℝ)) = (((U ×ˢ V) ∩ E).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, averageOn_mul_card, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hinner : ∀ x, averageOn V (fun y ↦ if (x, y) ∈ E then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (V.card : ℝ)
      = ((V.filter fun y ↦ (x, y) ∈ E).card : ℝ) := by
    intro x
    rw [averageOn_mul_card, Finset.sum_boole]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ hinner x]
  rw [card_product_inter_eq_sum_left E U V]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_averageOn_indicator_lt
statement:
theorem averageOn_averageOn_indicator_lt {E : Finset (X × Y)} {A : Finset X} {B : Finset Y}
    {ε : ℝ} (hE : E ⊆ A ×ˢ B) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hmass : (E.card : ℝ) < ε * A.card * B.card) :
    averageOn A (fun x ↦ averageOn B fun y ↦ if (x, y) ∈ E then (1 : ℝ) else 0) < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hApos : (0 : ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hA
  have hBpos : (0 : ℝ) < (B.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hB
  have hkey := averageOn_averageOn_indicator_mul E A B
  rw [Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hE] at hkey
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hpos, hkey]
  nlinarith

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_fiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fiber (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α) (B : Finset β)
    (b : β) : b ∈ fiber R a B ↔ b ∈ B ∧ R a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [fiber]

name: RegularityLemmata.fiber_subset
statement:
theorem fiber_subset (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α) (B : Finset β) :
    fiber R a B ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  exact (mem_fiber R a B b).1 hb |>.1

name: RegularityLemmata.fiber_mono
statement:
theorem fiber_mono (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α)
    {B C : Finset β} (hBC : B ⊆ C) : fiber R a B ⊆ fiber R a C
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  rw [mem_fiber] at hb ⊢
  exact ⟨hBC hb.1, hb.2⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.fiber_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiber_empty (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α) :
    fiber R a ∅ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [fiber]

name: RegularityLemmata.fiber_inter
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiber_inter (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq β]
    (a : α) (B C : Finset β) : fiber R a (B ∩ C) = fiber R a B ∩ C
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp [fiber, and_assoc, and_comm]

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_fiberFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fiberFamily (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq β]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (s : Finset β) :
    s ∈ fiberFamily R A B ↔ ∃ a ∈ A, fiber R a B = s
proof:
:= by
  simp [fiberFamily]

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_fiberFamily_subset
statement:
theorem mem_fiberFamily_subset (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq β]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) {s : Finset β} (hs : s ∈ fiberFamily R A B) : s ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_fiberFamily R A B s).1 hs
  exact fiber_subset R a B

name: RegularityLemmata.fiberFamily_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberFamily_empty_left (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    [DecidableEq β] (B : Finset β) : fiberFamily R ∅ B = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [fiberFamily]

name: RegularityLemmata.fiberFamily_empty_right
statement:
theorem fiberFamily_empty_right (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    [DecidableEq β] {A : Finset α} (hA : A.Nonempty) : fiberFamily R A ∅ = {∅}
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fiberFamily, fiber] using (Finset.image_const hA (∅ : Finset β))

name: RegularityLemmata.fiberFamily_mono_left
statement:
theorem fiberFamily_mono_left (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq β]
    {A A' : Finset α} (hAA' : A ⊆ A') (B : Finset β) :
    fiberFamily R A B ⊆ fiberFamily R A' B
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_fiberFamily R A B s).1 hs
  exact (mem_fiberFamily R A' B _).2 ⟨a, hAA' ha, rfl⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_right_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_right_iff {σ : CoordinateSplit n} {i : Fin n} :
    i ∈ σ.right ↔ i ∉ σ.left
proof:
:= by
  rw [right, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.isProper_iff
statement:
theorem isProper_iff {σ : CoordinateSplit n} :
    σ.IsProper ↔ σ.left.Nonempty ∧ ∃ i, i ∉ σ.left
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsProper]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨h1, i, mem_right_iff.mp hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨h1, i, mem_right_iff.mpr hi⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_apply_left {xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1} {xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1}
    {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∈ σ.left) : σ.glue xL xR i = xL ⟨i, hi⟩
proof: := dite_eq_left hi

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_apply_right {xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1} {xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1}
    {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∉ σ.left) : σ.glue xL xR i = xR ⟨i, hi⟩
proof: := dite_eq_right hi

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictLeft_glue
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictLeft_glue (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    σ.restrictLeft (σ.glue xL xR) = xL
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [restrictLeft, glue_apply_left i.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictRight_glue
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictRight_glue (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    σ.restrictRight (σ.glue xL xR) = xR
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [restrictRight, glue_apply_right i.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_restrict
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_restrict (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    σ.glue (σ.restrictLeft x) (σ.restrictRight x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ σ.left
  · rw [glue_apply_left hi, restrictLeft]
  · rw [glue_apply_right hi, restrictRight]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitEquiv_apply (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    σ.splitEquiv V x = (σ.restrictLeft x, σ.restrictRight x)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitEquiv_symm_apply
    (p : (∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) × (∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1)) :
    (σ.splitEquiv V).symm p = σ.glue p.1 p.2
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_left
statement: @[simp] theorem swap_left (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.left = σ.right
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_swap
statement: @[simp] theorem swap_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.swap = σ
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg CoordinateSplit.mk ?_
  ext i
  simp [swap, right]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swapLeftEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapLeftEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (i : σ.swap.Left) :
    (σ.swapLeftEquiv i).1 = i.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swapRightEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapRightEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (i : σ.swap.Right) :
    (σ.swapRightEquiv i).1 = i.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_glue
statement:
theorem swap_glue (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (xL : ∀ i : σ.swap.Left, V i.1)
    (xR : ∀ i : σ.swap.Right, V i.1) :
    σ.swap.glue xL xR
      = σ.glue (fun i => xR ⟨i.1, fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp h) i.2⟩)
          (fun i => xL ⟨i.1, mem_right_iff.mpr i.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ σ.left
  · rw [glue_apply_left hi,
      glue_apply_right (show i ∉ σ.swap.left from fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp h) hi)]
  · rw [glue_apply_right hi,
      glue_apply_left (show i ∈ σ.swap.left from mem_right_iff.mpr hi)]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictLeft_swap
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictLeft_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (x : ∀ i, V i) (i : σ.swap.Left) :
    σ.swap.restrictLeft x i = σ.restrictRight x (σ.swapLeftEquiv i)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictRight_swap
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictRight_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (x : ∀ i, V i) (i : σ.swap.Right) :
    σ.swap.restrictRight x i = σ.restrictLeft x (σ.swapRightEquiv i)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_reindex_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_reindex_left {σ : CoordinateSplit n} {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    {i : Fin n} : i ∈ (σ.reindex π).left ↔ π i ∈ σ.left
proof:
:= by
  rw [reindex, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    rwa [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · intro h
    exact ⟨π i, h, π.symm_apply_apply i⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexLeftEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindexLeftEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (i : (σ.reindex π).Left) : (σ.reindexLeftEquiv π i).1 = π i.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexRightEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindexRightEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (i : (σ.reindex π).Right) : (σ.reindexRightEquiv π i).1 = π i.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictLeft_reindex
statement:
theorem restrictLeft_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    (σ.reindex π).restrictLeft (V := fun i => V (π i)) (fun i => x (π i))
      = fun i => σ.restrictLeft x (σ.reindexLeftEquiv π i)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictRight_reindex
statement:
theorem restrictRight_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    (σ.reindex π).restrictRight (V := fun i => V (π i)) (fun i => x (π i))
      = fun i => σ.restrictRight x (σ.reindexRightEquiv π i)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_reindex
statement:
theorem glue_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    (σ.reindex π).glue (V := fun i => V (π i))
        (fun i => xL ⟨π i.1, mem_reindex_left.mp i.2⟩)
        (fun i => xR ⟨π i.1, fun h => i.2 (mem_reindex_left.mpr h)⟩)
      = fun i => σ.glue xL xR (π i)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : π i ∈ σ.left
  · rw [glue_apply_left (mem_reindex_left.mpr hi), glue_apply_left hi]
  · rw [glue_apply_right (fun h => hi (mem_reindex_left.mp h)), glue_apply_right hi]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitRel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitRel_apply (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1)
    (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) : σ.splitRel R xL xR ↔ R (σ.glue xL xR)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexRel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindexRel_apply (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    (y : ∀ i, V (π i)) : reindexRel π R y ↔ R (Equiv.piCongrLeft V π y)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexRel_comp
statement:
theorem reindexRel_comp (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    (x : ∀ i, V i) : reindexRel π R (fun i => x (π i)) ↔ R x
proof:
:= by
  rw [reindexRel, show (fun i => x (π i)) = (Equiv.piCongrLeft V π).symm x from rfl,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitRel_reindex
statement:
theorem splitRel_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    (σ.reindex π).splitRel (V := fun i => V (π i)) (reindexRel π R)
        (fun i => xL ⟨π i.1, mem_reindex_left.mp i.2⟩)
        (fun i => xR ⟨π i.1, fun h => i.2 (mem_reindex_left.mpr h)⟩)
      ↔ σ.splitRel R xL xR
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitRel_apply, splitRel_apply, glue_reindex]
  exact reindexRel_comp π R (σ.glue xL xR)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitRel_swap
statement:
theorem splitRel_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    (xL : ∀ i : σ.swap.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.swap.Right, V i.1) :
    
    
    
    σ.swap.splitRel R xL xR
      ↔ σ.splitRel R (fun i => xR ⟨i.1, fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp h) i.2⟩)
          (fun i => xL ⟨i.1, mem_right_iff.mpr i.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitRel_apply, splitRel_apply, swap_glue]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_right
statement: theorem swap_right (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.right = σ.left
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [swap, right]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_isProper
statement: theorem swap_isProper (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.IsProper ↔ σ.IsProper
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsProper, IsProper, swap_left, swap_right]
  exact and_comm

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindex_isProper
statement:
theorem reindex_isProper (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (σ.reindex π).IsProper ↔ σ.IsProper
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsProper, IsProper]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
    exact ⟨⟨π i, mem_reindex_left.mp hi⟩,
      ⟨π j, mem_right_iff.mpr fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp hj) (mem_reindex_left.mpr h)⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
    refine ⟨⟨π.symm i, mem_reindex_left.mpr ?_⟩, ⟨π.symm j, mem_right_iff.mpr ?_⟩⟩
    · rwa [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    · intro h
      have := mem_reindex_left.mp h
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
      exact (mem_right_iff.mp hj) this

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_singleton_left
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_singleton_left {i j : Fin n} : j ∈ ((singleton i : CoordinateSplit n)).left ↔ j = i
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton, Finset.mem_singleton]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.oneVsRest_apply
statement:
theorem oneVsRest_apply (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) (i : Fin n) (v : V i)
    (rest : ∀ j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i}, V j.1) :
    oneVsRest R i v rest ↔ R (fun j => if h : j = i then h ▸ v else rest ⟨j, h⟩)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singleton_isProper
statement: theorem singleton_isProper (i : Fin n) : (singleton i).IsProper ↔ ∃ j, j ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsProper]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨j, fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp hj) (mem_singleton_left.mpr h)⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, mem_singleton_left.mpr rfl⟩,
      ⟨j, mem_right_iff.mpr fun h => hj (mem_singleton_left.mp h)⟩⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singletonLeftEquiv_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem singletonLeftEquiv_symm_val (i : Fin n) (u : PUnit.{1}) :
    ((singletonLeftEquiv i).symm u).1 = i
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singletonRightEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem singletonRightEquiv_val (i : Fin n) (j : (singleton i).Right) :
    (singletonRightEquiv i j).1 = j.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singletonRightEquiv_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem singletonRightEquiv_symm_val (i : Fin n) (j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i}) :
    ((singletonRightEquiv i).symm j).1 = j.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_injective_iff
statement:
theorem glue_injective_iff {α : Type*} (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (xL : σ.Left → α)
    (xR : σ.Right → α) :
    Function.Injective (σ.glue (V := fun _ => α) xL xR) ↔
      Function.Injective xL ∧ Function.Injective xR ∧
        Disjoint (Set.range xL) (Set.range xR)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun a b hab => ?_, fun a b hab => ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Subtype.ext (h ?_)
      rw [glue_apply_left a.2, glue_apply_left b.2]
      simpa using hab
    · refine Subtype.ext (h ?_)
      rw [glue_apply_right a.2, glue_apply_right b.2]
      simpa using hab
    · rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro c ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
      have hval : σ.glue (V := fun _ => α) xL xR a.1 = σ.glue (V := fun _ => α) xL xR b.1 := by
        rw [glue_apply_left a.2, glue_apply_right b.2]
        simpa using hb.symm
      exact b.2 (h hval ▸ a.2)
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, hd⟩ i j hij
    by_cases hi : i ∈ σ.left <;> by_cases hj : j ∈ σ.left
    · rw [glue_apply_left hi, glue_apply_left hj] at hij
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hL hij)
    · rw [glue_apply_left hi, glue_apply_right hj] at hij
      exact absurd (Set.disjoint_left.mp hd ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hij.symm⟩) not_false
    · rw [glue_apply_right hi, glue_apply_left hj] at hij
      exact absurd (Set.disjoint_left.mp hd ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hij⟩) not_false
    · rw [glue_apply_right hi, glue_apply_right hj] at hij
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hR hij)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.card_piFinset_split
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_split [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] [∀ i, Fintype (V i)]
    (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : ∀ i, Finset (V i)) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).card
      = (Fintype.piFinset fun i : σ.Left => A i.1).card
        * (Fintype.piFinset fun i : σ.Right => A i.1).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Fintype.card_piFinset, Fintype.card_piFinset]
  have hL : (∏ i : σ.Left, (A i.1).card) = ∏ i ∈ σ.left, (A i).card :=
    Finset.prod_coe_sort σ.left (fun i => (A i).card)
  have hR : (∏ i : σ.Right, (A i.1).card) = ∏ i ∈ σ.right, (A i).card := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_coe_sort σ.right (fun i => (A i).card)]
    exact Fintype.prod_equiv σ.rightEquiv _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  have hsplit : (∏ i, (A i).card)
      = (∏ i ∈ σ.left, (A i).card) * (∏ i ∈ σ.right, (A i).card) := by
    rw [right, ← Finset.prod_union Finset.disjoint_sdiff,
      Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)]
  rw [hsplit, hL, hR]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem averageOn_empty (φ : α → ℝ) : averageOn (∅ : Finset α) φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [averageOn]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_mul_card
statement:
theorem averageOn_mul_card (S : Finset α) (φ : α → ℝ) :
    averageOn S φ * S.card = ∑ x ∈ S, φ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · have h0 : (S.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hS
    rw [averageOn, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_const
statement: theorem averageOn_const (hS : S.Nonempty) (c : ℝ) : averageOn S (fun _ ↦ c) = c
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (S.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hS
  rw [averageOn, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self h0,
    mul_one]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_congr
statement: theorem averageOn_congr (h : ∀ x ∈ S, φ x = ψ x) : averageOn S φ = averageOn S ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [averageOn, averageOn, Finset.sum_congr rfl h]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_nonneg
statement: theorem averageOn_nonneg (h : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ φ x) : 0 ≤ averageOn S φ
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg h) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_le_of_le
statement: theorem averageOn_le_of_le (h : ∀ x ∈ S, φ x ≤ c) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : averageOn S φ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simpa using hc
  · have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < (S.card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hS
    rw [averageOn, div_le_iff₀ h0]
    calc ∑ x ∈ S, φ x ≤ ∑ _x ∈ S, c := Finset.sum_le_sum h
      _ = c * S.card := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem averageOn_mem_Icc (h : ∀ x ∈ S, φ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    averageOn S φ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨averageOn_nonneg fun x hx ↦ (h x hx).1, averageOn_le_of_le (fun x hx ↦ (h x hx).2) one_pos.le⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_indicator
statement:
theorem averageOn_indicator (S : Finset α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    averageOn S (fun x ↦ if p x then 1 else 0) = densityOn S p
proof:
:= by
  rw [averageOn, densityOn, Finset.sum_boole]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverageCount_eq_averageOn_left
statement:
theorem rectAverageCount_eq_averageOn_left (f : RectKernel X Y) (A : Finset X)
    (B : Finset Y) :
    rectAverageCount f A B = averageOn A fun x ↦ averageOn B (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectAverageCount, rectAverage, rectSum, finsetMass, one_mul, averageOn,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_div, mul_comm ((B.card : ℝ)) _]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverageCount_eq_averageOn_right
statement:
theorem rectAverageCount_eq_averageOn_right (f : RectKernel X Y) (A : Finset X)
    (B : Finset Y) :
    rectAverageCount f A B = averageOn B fun y ↦ averageOn A fun x ↦ f x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectAverageCount, rectAverage, rectSum, finsetMass, one_mul, averageOn,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_div, div_div]

name: RegularityLemmata.lowerFace_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem lowerFace_apply {j : ℕ} (v : Fin (j + 1) → α) (i : Fin (j + 1)) (k : Fin j) :
    lowerFace v i k = v (i.succAbove k)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_succAbove
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_succAbove {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ}
    (A : Fin (n + 1) → Finset α) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → α) → M) :
    ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, f w
      = ∑ rest ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ A (j.succAbove i)), ∑ b ∈ A j,
          f (Fin.insertNth j b rest)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_product' (s := Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ A (j.succAbove i))) (t := A j)
    (f := fun rest b ↦ f (Fin.insertNth j b rest))]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun q ↦ Fin.insertNth j q.2 q.1)
    (fun w ↦ (Fin.removeNth j w, w j)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨rest, b⟩ hq
    rw [Finset.mem_product] at hq
    rw [Fin.mem_piFinset_iff_pivot_removeNth j]
    simpa [Fin.removeNth, Fintype.mem_piFinset] using ⟨hq.2, Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hq.1⟩
  · intro w hw
    rw [Fin.mem_piFinset_iff_pivot_removeNth j] at hw
    rw [Finset.mem_product]
    exact ⟨hw.2, hw.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨rest, b⟩ _
    simp
  · intro w _
    simp
  · rintro ⟨rest, b⟩ _
    rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_apply_mem
statement:
theorem card_filter_apply_mem [DecidableEq α] {s D : Finset α} (hD : D ⊆ s) {n : ℕ}
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ x j ∈ D).card
      = D.card * s.card ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.card_filter, sum_piFinset_succAbove (fun _ ↦ s) j]
  simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Fintype.card_piFinset_const, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.card_filter,
    Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hD]
  exact Nat.mul_comm _ _

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_exists_apply_mem_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_exists_apply_mem_le [DecidableEq α] {s D : Finset α} (hD : D ⊆ s) (n : ℕ) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ ∃ i, x i ∈ D).card
      ≤ (n + 1) * D.card * s.card ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ ∃ i, x i ∈ D).card
      ≤ (Finset.univ.biUnion fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ x j ∈ D).card := by
        refine Finset.card_le_card fun x hx ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
        obtain ⟨hxs, j, hj⟩ := hx
        rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
        exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxs, hj⟩⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin (n + 1),
          ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ x j ∈ D).card :=
        Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ = (n + 1) * D.card * s.card ^ n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ card_filter_apply_mem hD j, Finset.sum_const,
          Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
        exact (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.lowerFace_injective
statement:
theorem lowerFace_injective {j : ℕ} {v : Fin (j + 1) → α} (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (i : Fin (j + 1)) : Function.Injective (lowerFace v i)
proof:
:=
  hv.comp Fin.succAbove_right_injective

name: RegularityLemmata.succAbove_faces_three
statement:
theorem succAbove_faces_three :
    ((0 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 1 ∧ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 2) ∧
    ((1 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 2) ∧
    ((2 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 0 ∧ (2 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 1)
proof: := by decide

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace
statement:
@[simp] theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace (v : Fin 3 → α) (i : Fin 3) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v i) = (v (i.succAbove 0), v (i.succAbove 1))
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_zero
statement:
theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_zero (v : Fin 3 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v 0) = (v 1, v 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace,
    show (0 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 1 from by decide,
    show (0 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 2 from by decide]

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_one
statement:
theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_one (v : Fin 3 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v 1) = (v 0, v 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace,
    show (1 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 0 from by decide,
    show (1 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 2 from by decide]

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_two
statement:
theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_two (v : Fin 3 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v 2) = (v 0, v 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace,
    show (2 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 0 from by decide,
    show (2 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 1 from by decide]

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_map_finTwoArrowEquiv
statement:
theorem mem_map_finTwoArrowEquiv (P : Finset (Fin 2 → α)) (w : Fin 2 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α w ∈ P.map (finTwoArrowEquiv α).toEmbedding ↔ w ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_map_equiv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: RegularityLemmata.card_piFinset_one
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_one (A : Fin 1 → Finset α) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).card = (A 0).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Fin.prod_univ_one]

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_one
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_one (A : Fin 1 → Finset α) (R : (Fin 1 → α) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] :
    ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).card = ((A 0).filter fun a ↦ R ![a]).card
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_bij' (fun x _ ↦ x 0) (fun a _ ↦ ![a]) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
    refine ⟨Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hx.1 0, ?_⟩
    rw [show (![x 0] : Fin 1 → α) = x from funext fun i ↦ by fin_cases i; rfl]
    exact hx.2
  · intro a ha
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ha ⊢
    refine ⟨Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr fun i ↦ ?_, ha.2⟩
    fin_cases i
    simpa using ha.1
  · intro x hx
    exact funext fun i ↦ by fin_cases i; rfl
  · intro a ha
    simp

name: RegularityLemmata.image_finTwoArrowEquiv_piFinset
statement:
theorem image_finTwoArrowEquiv_piFinset [DecidableEq α] (A : Fin 2 → Finset α) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).image (finTwoArrowEquiv α) = A 0 ×ˢ A 1
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩
    have h0 : f 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst hfe
    have h1 : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hfe
    exact ⟨h0 ▸ Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hf 0, h1 ▸ Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hf 1⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    refine ⟨![a, b], Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr fun i => ?_, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using ha
    · simpa using hb

name: RegularityLemmata.card_piFinset_two
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_two (A : Fin 2 → Finset α) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).card = (A 0).card * (A 1).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Fin.prod_univ_two]

name: RegularityLemmata.filter_piFinset_two_image
statement:
theorem filter_piFinset_two_image [DecidableEq α] (A : Fin 2 → Finset α)
    (R : (Fin 2 → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred R] :
    ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).image (finTwoArrowEquiv α) =
      (A 0 ×ˢ A 1).filter fun p => R ![p.1, p.2]
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hf
    have h0 : f 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst hfe
    have h1 : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hfe
    have hfeq : f = ![a, b] := by
      funext i; fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
    refine ⟨⟨h0 ▸ Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hf.1 0, h1 ▸ Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hf.1 1⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hfeq]
    exact hf.2
  · rintro ⟨⟨ha, hb⟩, hR⟩
    refine ⟨![a, b],
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr fun i => ?_, hR⟩, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using ha
    · simpa using hb

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_two
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_two [DecidableEq α] (A : Fin 2 → Finset α)
    (R : (Fin 2 → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred R] :
    ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).card =
      ((A 0 ×ˢ A 1).filter fun p => R ![p.1, p.2]).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← filter_piFinset_two_image A R]
  exact (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (finTwoArrowEquiv α).injective).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.titu_finset
statement:
theorem titu_finset {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (f g : ι → ℝ) (I : Finset ι)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ g i) (hfg : ∀ i ∈ I, g i = 0 → f i = 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, f i) ^ 2 / (∑ i ∈ I, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, f i ^ 2 / g i
proof:
:= by
  set P := I.filter fun i => 0 < g i with hP
  have hzero : ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ 0 < g i → g i = 0 := fun i hi hng =>
    le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hng) (hg i hi)
  have hsumf : ∑ i ∈ I, f i = ∑ i ∈ P, f i := by
    rw [hP]
    refine (Finset.sum_filter_of_ne fun i hi hfi => ?_).symm
    by_contra hng
    exact hfi (hfg i hi (hzero i hi hng))
  have hsumg : ∑ i ∈ I, g i = ∑ i ∈ P, g i := by
    rw [hP]
    refine (Finset.sum_filter_of_ne fun i hi hgi => ?_).symm
    by_contra hng
    exact hgi (hzero i hi hng)
  calc (∑ i ∈ I, f i) ^ 2 / ∑ i ∈ I, g i
      = (∑ i ∈ P, f i) ^ 2 / ∑ i ∈ P, g i := by rw [hsumf, hsumg]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ P, f i ^ 2 / g i :=
        Finset.sq_sum_div_le_sum_sq_div P f fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, f i ^ 2 / g i := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          fun i hi _ => ?_
        exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hg i hi)

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_sum_mul_le_sum_mul_sum_sq_mul
statement:
theorem sq_sum_mul_le_sum_mul_sum_sq_mul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (a m : ι → ℝ)
    (I : Finset ι) (hm : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ m i) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, a i * m i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, m i) * ∑ i ∈ I, a i ^ 2 * m i
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ I, (a i * m i) ^ 2 / m i = a i ^ 2 * m i := by
    intro i _
    rcases eq_or_ne (m i) 0 with h | h
    · rw [h, div_zero, mul_zero]
    · field_simp
  have htitu := titu_finset (fun i => a i * m i) m I hm (fun i _ h => by rw [h, mul_zero])
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm] at htitu
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Finset.sum_nonneg hm) with h0 | hpos
  · 
    have hz : ∀ i ∈ I, m i = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      by_contra hne
      exact absurd h0.symm (ne_of_gt (Finset.sum_pos' hm
        ⟨i, hi, lt_of_le_of_ne (hm i hi) (Ne.symm hne)⟩))
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by rw [hz i hi, mul_zero], ← h0]
    norm_num
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos] at htitu
    calc (∑ i ∈ I, a i * m i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, a i ^ 2 * m i) * ∑ i ∈ I, m i := htitu
      _ = (∑ i ∈ I, m i) * ∑ i ∈ I, a i ^ 2 * m i := by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.titu_two
statement:
theorem titu_two {a b p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (ha : p = 0 → a = 0) (hb : q = 0 → b = 0) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (p + q) ≤ a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q
proof:
:= by
  have := titu_finset (![a, b]) (![p, q]) Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => by fin_cases i <;> assumption)
    (fun i _ => by fin_cases i <;> assumption)
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using this

name: RegularityLemmata.titu_three
statement:
theorem titu_three {a b c p q r : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (ha : p = 0 → a = 0) (hb : q = 0 → b = 0) (hc : r = 0 → c = 0) :
    (a + b + c) ^ 2 / (p + q + r) ≤ a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q + c ^ 2 / r
proof:
:= by
  have := titu_finset (![a, b, c]) (![p, q, r]) Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => by fin_cases i <;> assumption)
    (fun i _ => by fin_cases i <;> assumption)
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three, add_assoc] using this

name: RegularityLemmata.engel_defect_lower
statement:
theorem engel_defect_lower {a b p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (p + q) + p * (a / p - (a + b) / (p + q)) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : (0 : ℝ) < p + q := by linarith
  have key : a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q
      - ((a + b) ^ 2 / (p + q) + p * (a / p - (a + b) / (p + q)) ^ 2)
      = (a * q - b * p) ^ 2 / (q * (p + q) ^ 2) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (a * q - b * p) ^ 2 / (q * (p + q) ^ 2) := by positivity
  linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_mul_sub_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_mul_sub_mul_le {x y d e : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (he : |e| ≤ 1) :
    |x * y - d * e| ≤ |x - d| + |y - e|
proof:
:= by
  have key : x * y - d * e = x * (y - e) + e * (x - d) := by ring
  rw [key]
  calc |x * (y - e) + e * (x - d)|
      ≤ |x * (y - e)| + |e * (x - d)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |x| * |y - e| + |e| * |x - d| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * |y - e| + 1 * |x - d| :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (abs_nonneg _))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (abs_nonneg _))
    _ = |x - d| + |y - e| := by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_mul_mul_sub_mul_mul_le
proof:
:= by
  have key : a * b * c - a' * b' * c'
      = (a - a') * b * c + a' * (b - b') * c + a' * b' * (c - c') := by ring
  rw [key]
  have h1 : |(a - a') * b * c| ≤ |a - a'| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    calc |a - a'| * |b| * |c| ≤ |a - a'| * 1 * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = |a - a'| := by ring
  have h2 : |a' * (b - b') * c| ≤ |b - b'| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    calc |a'| * |b - b'| * |c| ≤ 1 * |b - b'| * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = |b - b'| := by ring
  have h3 : |a' * b' * (c - c')| ≤ |c - c'| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    calc |a'| * |b'| * |c - c'| ≤ 1 * 1 * |c - c'| := by gcongr
      _ = |c - c'| := by ring
  have hstep : |(a - a') * b * c + a' * (b - b') * c + a' * b' * (c - c')|
      ≤ |(a - a') * b * c| + |a' * (b - b') * c| + |a' * b' * (c - c')| := by
    have hxy := abs_add_le ((a - a') * b * c) (a' * (b - b') * c)
    have hxyz := abs_add_le ((a - a') * b * c + a' * (b - b') * c) (a' * b' * (c - c'))
    linarith
  linarith [hstep, h1, h2, h3]

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_mul_le_sum_filter_nonneg
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_filter_nonneg {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {c : ι → ℝ} (I : Finset ι)
    (hc0 : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ c i) (hc1 : ∀ i ∈ I, c i ≤ 1) (y : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i ≤ ∑ i ∈ I.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ y i), y i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, max (y i) 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
        rcases le_or_gt 0 (y i) with h | h
        · calc c i * y i ≤ 1 * y i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc1 i hi) h
            _ = y i := one_mul _
            _ ≤ max (y i) 0 := le_max_left _ _
        · calc c i * y i ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hc0 i hi) h.le
            _ ≤ max (y i) 0 := le_max_right _ _
    _ = ∑ i ∈ I.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ y i), y i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases h : 0 ≤ y i
        · simp [h]
        · simp [h, max_eq_right (not_le.mp h).le]

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_filter_neg_le_sum_mul
statement:
theorem sum_filter_neg_le_sum_mul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {c : ι → ℝ} (I : Finset ι)
    (hc0 : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ c i) (hc1 : ∀ i ∈ I, c i ≤ 1) (y : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ I.filter (fun i => y i < 0), y i ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc ∑ i ∈ I.filter (fun i => y i < 0), y i
      = ∑ i ∈ I, min (y i) 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases h : y i < 0
        · simp [h, min_eq_left h.le]
        · simp [h, min_eq_right (not_lt.mp h)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
        rcases le_or_gt 0 (y i) with h | h
        · calc min (y i) 0 ≤ 0 := min_le_right _ _
            _ ≤ c i * y i := mul_nonneg (hc0 i hi) h
        · calc min (y i) 0 = y i := min_eq_left h.le
            _ = 1 * y i := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ c i * y i := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right (hc1 i hi) h.le

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sum_bilinear_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hswap : ∀ I' ⊆ I, ∑ i ∈ I', (∑ j ∈ J, d j * x i j)
      = ∑ j ∈ J, d j * (∑ i ∈ I', x i j) := by
    intro I' _
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  set y : ι → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j ∈ J, d j * x i j with hy
  refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    set I' : Finset ι := I.filter (fun i => y i < 0) with hI'
    have hI'sub : I' ⊆ I := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ I', y i ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i :=
      sum_filter_neg_le_sum_mul I hc0 hc1 y
    set z : κ → ℝ := fun j => ∑ i ∈ I', x i j with hz
    set J' : Finset κ := J.filter (fun j => z j < 0) with hJ'
    have h2 : ∑ j ∈ J', z j ≤ ∑ j ∈ J, d j * z j :=
      sum_filter_neg_le_sum_mul J hd0 hd1 z
    have h3 : ∑ i ∈ I', y i = ∑ j ∈ J, d j * z j := by rw [hy, hswap I' hI'sub]
    have h4 : ∑ j ∈ J', z j = ∑ i ∈ I', ∑ j ∈ J', x i j := by
      rw [hz]; exact (Finset.sum_comm).symm
    have h5 : -ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ I', ∑ j ∈ J', x i j :=
      (abs_le.mp (hrect I' hI'sub J' (Finset.filter_subset _ _))).1
    linarith [h1, h2, h3 ▸ h2, h4 ▸ h5]
  · 
    set I' : Finset ι := I.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ y i) with hI'
    have hI'sub : I' ⊆ I := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i ≤ ∑ i ∈ I', y i :=
      sum_mul_le_sum_filter_nonneg I hc0 hc1 y
    set z : κ → ℝ := fun j => ∑ i ∈ I', x i j with hz
    set J' : Finset κ := J.filter (fun j => 0 ≤ z j) with hJ'
    have h2 : ∑ j ∈ J, d j * z j ≤ ∑ j ∈ J', z j :=
      sum_mul_le_sum_filter_nonneg J hd0 hd1 z
    have h3 : ∑ i ∈ I', y i = ∑ j ∈ J, d j * z j := by rw [hy, hswap I' hI'sub]
    have h4 : ∑ j ∈ J', z j = ∑ i ∈ I', ∑ j ∈ J', x i j := by
      rw [hz]; exact (Finset.sum_comm).symm
    have h5 : ∑ i ∈ I', ∑ j ∈ J', x i j ≤ ε :=
      (abs_le.mp (hrect I' hI'sub J' (Finset.filter_subset _ _))).2
    linarith [h1, h2, h3, h4 ▸ h5]

name: RegularityLemmata.exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq_half
statement:
theorem exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 - x + x ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - x + x ^ 2 / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 1)]
  have hexp := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg hx
  have hpos : 0 < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
  rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ hpos]
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - x + x ^ 2 / 2) * (1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 2)]
    _ ≤ (1 - x + x ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hq

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_def
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousCell_def [instι : DecidableEq ι] [instR : DecidablePred R] :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A ε ↔ tupleDensity R A ≤ ε ∨ 1 - ε ≤ tupleDensity R A
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsHomogeneousCell
  rw [show (fun i j ↦ Classical.dec (i = j) : DecidableEq ι) = instι from
      funext fun i ↦ funext fun j ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show (fun x ↦ Classical.dec (R x) : DecidablePred R) = instR from
      funext fun x ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _]

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.mono
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.mono (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A ε) (hε : ε ≤ ε') :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A ε'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (h.trans hε)
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_of_half_le
statement: theorem isHomogeneousCell_of_half_le (hε : 1 / 2 ≤ ε) : IsHomogeneousCell R A ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def]
  rcases le_or_gt (tupleDensity R A) (1 / 2) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (h.trans hε)
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_of_side_empty
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousCell_of_side_empty [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def]
  exact Or.inl (by rw [tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty (R := R) hi]; exact hε)

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_of_isEmpty_index
statement: theorem isHomogeneousCell_of_isEmpty_index [IsEmpty ι] : IsHomogeneousCell R A 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def]
  have hcard : (Fintype.piFinset A).card = 1 := by simp
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (tupleCount R A) 1 with h | h
  · left
    rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, Nat.lt_one_iff.mp h]
    simp
  · right
    have h1 : tupleCount R A = 1 := le_antisymm (hcard ▸ tupleCount_le_card) h
    rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, h1, hcard]
    norm_num

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_one_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousCell_one_iff {R₁ : (Fin 1 → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred R₁]
    {A₁ : Fin 1 → Finset α} :
    IsHomogeneousCell R₁ A₁ ε ↔ densityOn (A₁ 0) (fun a ↦ R₁ ![a]) ≤ ε
      ∨ 1 - ε ≤ densityOn (A₁ 0) fun a ↦ R₁ ![a]
proof:
:= by
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def, tupleDensity_one_eq]

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_pairDensity
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_eq_pairDensity [DecidableEq α] (R₂ : (Fin 2 → α) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R₂] (A₂ : Fin 2 → Finset α) :
    tupleDensity R₂ A₂ = pairDensity (fun a b ↦ R₂ ![a, b]) (A₂ 0) (A₂ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleDensity_two_eq, pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairCount]

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_two_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def, isHomogeneousPair_def, tupleDensity_eq_pairDensity]

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.subset_zero
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.subset_zero (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A 0) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A' 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def] at h ⊢
  have hmass : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rcases h with h | h
  · 
    left
    have hzero : tupleCount R A = 0 := by
      have hle : (tupleCount R A : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
        have := card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le h
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast le_antisymm hle (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) _)
    have hzero' : tupleCount R A' = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp (hzero ▸ tupleCount_mono hA)
    rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, hzero']
    simp
  · 
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    have hnot : tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A = 0 := by
      have hR : (1 : ℝ) * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A : ℝ) :=
        le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity h
      have hsum := tupleCount_add_neg (R := R) (A := A)
      have hcard : ((Fintype.piFinset A).card : ℝ) = ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod]
      have hle : ((Fintype.piFinset A).card : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A : ℝ) := by
        rw [hcard]; linarith
      have h1 : (Fintype.piFinset A).card ≤ tupleCount R A := by exact_mod_cast hle
      have h2 : tupleCount R A ≤ (Fintype.piFinset A).card := tupleCount_le_card
      omega
    have hnot' : tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A' = 0 :=
      Nat.le_zero.mp (hnot ▸ tupleCount_mono (R := fun x ↦ ¬ R x) hA)
    rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty (Fintype.piFinset A') with hemp | hne
    · left
      rw [tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty hemp]
    · right
      rw [sub_zero]
      have hd : tupleDensity (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A' = 0 := by
        rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, hnot']
        simp
      rw [tupleDensity_neg (Fintype.piFinset_nonempty.mp hne)] at hd
      linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_restrict_le
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_restrict_le [DecidableEq ι] {S : (ι → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred S]
    {c : ℝ} {ρ : ι → ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hcard : ∀ i, ρ i * ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ ((A' i).card : ℝ))
    (hS : (tupleCount S A : ℝ) ≤ c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)) :
    tupleDensity S A' ≤ c / ∏ i, ρ i
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, ρ i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hρ i
  have hmass' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ) := Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hmass' with hzero | hpos
  · rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod, ← hzero, div_zero]
    exact div_nonneg hc hP.le
  · 
    have hprod : (∏ i, ρ i) * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hρ i).le (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        fun i _ ↦ hcard i
    have hcount : (tupleCount S A' : ℝ) ≤ c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) :=
      le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (tupleCount_mono hA)) hS
    rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod,
      div_le_div_iff₀ hpos hP]
    calc (tupleCount S A' : ℝ) * ∏ i, ρ i
        ≤ (c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)) * ∏ i, ρ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hP.le
      _ = c * ((∏ i, ρ i) * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ c * ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod hc

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.restrict
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.restrict {ρ : ι → ℝ} (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A ε) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hcard : ∀ i, ρ i * ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A' (ε / ∏ i, ρ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, ρ i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hρ i
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (tupleDensity_restrict_le hε hρ hA hcard (card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le h))
  · 
    have hcardA : ((Fintype.piFinset A).card : ℝ) = ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := by
      rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod]
    have hnotcount : (tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A : ℝ) ≤ ε * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := by
      have hR : (1 - ε) * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A : ℝ) :=
        le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity h
      have hsum : (tupleCount R A : ℝ) + (tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A : ℝ)
          = ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hcardA]
        exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast (R := ℝ)) (tupleCount_add_neg (R := R) (A := A))
      linarith
    have hnotd : tupleDensity (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A' ≤ ε / ∏ i, ρ i :=
      tupleDensity_restrict_le hε hρ hA hcard hnotcount
    rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty (Fintype.piFinset A') with hemp | hne
    · left
      rw [tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty hemp]
      positivity
    · right
      rw [tupleDensity_neg (Fintype.piFinset_nonempty.mp hne)] at hnotd
      linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.prod_sub_prod_le_card_mul_of_le
statement:
theorem prod_sub_prod_le_card_mul_of_le {s : Finset ι} {b p : ι → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i) (hbp : ∀ i ∈ s, b i ≤ p i)
    (hgrow : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ≤ (1 + γ) * b i) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, p i) - ∏ i ∈ s, b i ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * γ * ∏ i ∈ s, p i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    have hb' : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i := fun i hi ↦ hb i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have hbp' : ∀ i ∈ s, b i ≤ p i := fun i hi ↦ hbp i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have hgrow' : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ≤ (1 + γ) * b i := fun i hi ↦ hgrow i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have hrec := ih hb' hbp' hgrow'
    have hBs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, b i := Finset.prod_nonneg hb'
    have hPs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, p i :=
      Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi ↦ (hb' i hi).trans (hbp' i hi)
    have hba : 0 ≤ b a := hb a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have hbpa : b a ≤ p a := hbp a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have hga : p a ≤ (1 + γ) * b a := hgrow a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha]
    push_cast
    
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hba hPs, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrec hba,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sub_nonneg.mpr hbpa) hPs,
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hbpa) hγ) hPs,
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) s.card) hγ) hPs,
      mul_nonneg hγ hPs]

name: RegularityLemmata.prod_card_sub_le_of_grow
statement:
theorem prod_card_sub_le_of_grow [DecidableEq ι] {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hgrow : ∀ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + γ) * ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    (∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)) - ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * γ * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  prod_sub_prod_le_card_mul_of_le hγ (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _)
