    (fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card (hA i))) fun i _ ↦ hgrow i

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_tupleDensity_sub_le_of_grow
statement:
theorem abs_tupleDensity_sub_le_of_grow [DecidableEq ι] [DecidablePred R] {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i) (hgrow : ∀ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + γ) * ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    |tupleDensity R A - tupleDensity R A'| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * γ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hmA' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ) := Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hmA' with hzero | hpos
  · 
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero.symm
    have hi' : (A' i).card = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hi
    have hAi : (A i).card = 0 := by
      have := hgrow i
      rw [hi] at this
      have h0 : ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
      exact_mod_cast le_antisymm h0 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    rw [tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty (R := R) (Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hAi),
      tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty (R := R) (Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hi')]
    simpa using mul_nonneg hn0 hγ
  · have hmAle : (∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) :=
      Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card (hA i))
    have hposA : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hmAle
    have htel := prod_card_sub_le_of_grow (A := A) (A' := A') hγ hA hgrow
    
    have hmono : (tupleCount R A' : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (tupleCount_mono hA)
    have hsmall : (tupleCount R A' : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ) := by
      have := tupleCount_le_card (R := R) (A := A')
      rw [Fintype.card_piFinset] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hgap : (tupleCount R A : ℝ) + ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ)
        ≤ (tupleCount R A' : ℝ) + ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := by
      have hnat : tupleCount R A + (Fintype.piFinset A').card
          ≤ tupleCount R A' + (Fintype.piFinset A).card := by
        have hsub : Fintype.piFinset A' ⊆ Fintype.piFinset A := Fintype.piFinset_subset _ _ hA
        have hcover : (Fintype.piFinset A).filter R
            ⊆ ((Fintype.piFinset A').filter R) ∪ (Fintype.piFinset A \ Fintype.piFinset A') := by
          intro x hx
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
          by_cases hxa : x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A'
          · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxa, hx.2⟩)
          · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx.1, hxa⟩)
        have h1 : tupleCount R A
            ≤ tupleCount R A' + (Fintype.piFinset A \ Fintype.piFinset A').card :=
          le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hcover) (Finset.card_union_le _ _)
        have h2 : (Fintype.piFinset A \ Fintype.piFinset A').card + (Fintype.piFinset A').card
            = (Fintype.piFinset A).card := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hsub
        omega
      have hcA : ((Fintype.piFinset A).card : ℝ) = ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod]
      have hcA' : ((Fintype.piFinset A').card : ℝ) = ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod]
      have := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mpr hnat
      push_cast at this
      rw [hcA, hcA'] at this
      linarith
    have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A' : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    rw [tupleDensity_eq_count_div, tupleDensity_eq_count_div, Fintype.card_piFinset,
      Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_prod, abs_sub_le_iff]
    constructor
    · rw [div_sub_div _ _ hposA.ne' hpos.ne', div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hposA hpos)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htel hmA',
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmAle) hN0]
    · rw [div_sub_div _ _ hpos.ne' hposA.ne', div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hpos hposA)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htel hmA',
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sub_nonneg.mpr hmAle) (sub_nonneg.mpr hsmall)]

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.of_abs_tupleDensity_sub_le
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.of_abs_tupleDensity_sub_le [DecidableEq ι] [DecidablePred R] {γ : ℝ}
    (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A' ε)
    (hclose : |tupleDensity R A - tupleDensity R A'| ≤ γ) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A (ε + γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isHomogeneousCell_def] at h ⊢
  rw [abs_le] at hclose
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith [hclose.2])
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith [hclose.1])

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.of_grow
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.of_grow [DecidableEq ι] [DecidablePred R] {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A' ε) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hgrow : ∀ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + γ) * ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A (ε + (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * γ)
proof:
:=
  h.of_abs_tupleDensity_sub_le (abs_tupleDensity_sub_le_of_grow hγ hA hgrow)

name: RegularityLemmata.relationKernel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationKernel_apply (a : α) (b : β) :
    relationKernel R a b = if R a b then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_relationKernel
statement:
theorem isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) : IsUnitIntervalOnRectangle (relationKernel R) A B
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ b _
  rw [Set.mem_Icc, relationKernel]
  split <;> norm_num

name: RegularityLemmata.isAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle_relationKernel
statement:
theorem isAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle (relationKernel R) A B
proof:
:=
  (isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_relationKernel R A B).absBounded (by norm_num) le_rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectSum_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectSum (relationKernel R) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) A B = (pairCount R A B : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rectSum, pairCount, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  push_cast
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by
    rw [relationKernel]
    split <;> norm_num

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSumCount_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectSumCount_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectSumCount (relationKernel R) A B = (pairCount R A B : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  rectSum_relationKernel R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectAverage_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectAverage (relationKernel R) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) A B = pairDensity R A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectAverage, rectSum_relationKernel, finsetMass_one, finsetMass_one,
    pairDensity_eq_count_div]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverageCount_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectAverageCount_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectAverageCount (relationKernel R) A B = pairDensity R A B
proof:
:=
  rectAverage_relationKernel R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.relationKernel_op
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationKernel_op (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] :
    (relationKernel R).op = relationKernel (swapRel R)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.relationKernel_not
statement:
theorem relationKernel_not (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α) (b : β) :
    relationKernel (fun a b => ¬ R a b) a b = 1 - relationKernel R a b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : R a b <;> simp [relationKernel, h]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectIndicator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectIndicator_apply (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    rectIndicator S T a b = if a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ T then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_rectIndicator (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (A : Finset α)
    (B : Finset β) : IsUnitIntervalOnRectangle (rectIndicator S T) A B
proof:
:=
  isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_relationKernel _ A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSum_rectIndicator (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (wX : α → ℝ) (wY : β → ℝ)
    (S' : Finset α) (T' : Finset β) :
    rectSum (rectIndicator S T) wX wY S' T' = finsetMass wX (S' ∩ S) * finsetMass wY (T' ∩ T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, finsetMass, finsetMass, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter,
    ← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hx
  · rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
    rw [rectIndicator_apply]
    split_ifs with hy <;> simp_all
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y _ => ?_
    rw [rectIndicator_apply]
    split_ifs with hy <;> simp_all

name: RegularityLemmata.rectIndicator_op
statement:
theorem rectIndicator_op (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) :
    (rectIndicator S T).op = rectIndicator T S
proof:
:= by
  funext b a
  simp [RectKernel.op, rectIndicator, relationKernel, and_comm]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectCombination_apply (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α)
    (T : Fin n → Finset β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    rectCombination c S T a b = ∑ k, c k * rectIndicator (S k) (T k) a b
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectCombination_zero (c : Fin 0 → ℝ) (S : Fin 0 → Finset α)
    (T : Fin 0 → Finset β) : rectCombination c S T = fun _ _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a b; simp [rectCombination]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_rectCombination
statement:
theorem rectSum_rectCombination (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α) (T : Fin n → Finset β)
    (wX : α → ℝ) (wY : β → ℝ) (S' : Finset α) (T' : Finset β) :
    rectSum (rectCombination c S T) wX wY S' T'
      = ∑ k, c k * (finsetMass wX (S' ∩ S k) * finsetMass wY (T' ∩ T k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rectCombination
  rw [rectSum_finset_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [rectSum_smul, rectSum_rectIndicator]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_snoc
statement:
theorem rectCombination_snoc (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α) (T : Fin n → Finset β)
    (a : ℝ) (S₀ : Finset α) (T₀ : Finset β) :
    rectCombination (Fin.snoc c a) (Fin.snoc S S₀) (Fin.snoc T T₀)
      = fun x y => rectCombination c S T x y + a * rectIndicator S₀ T₀ x y
proof:
:= by
  funext x y
  simp only [rectCombination_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_op
statement:
theorem rectCombination_op (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α) (T : Fin n → Finset β) :
    (rectCombination c S T).op = rectCombination c T S
proof:
:= by
  funext y x
  simp only [RectKernel.op, rectCombination_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [← rectIndicator_op]
  rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_mul_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSum_mul_rectIndicator (f : RectKernel α β) (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    rectSum (fun x y => f x y * rectIndicator S T x y) wX wY A B = rectSum f wX wY S T
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, rectSum, ← Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hS, ← Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hT,
    ← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, ← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hx
  · rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
    rw [rectIndicator_apply]
    split_ifs with hy <;> simp_all
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y _ => ?_
    rw [rectIndicator_apply]
    split_ifs with hy <;> simp_all

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_sub_smul_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSqMass_sub_smul_rectIndicator (f : RectKernel α β) (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B)
    (a : ℝ) :
    rectSqMass (fun x y => f x y - a * rectIndicator S T x y) wX wY A B
      = rectSqMass f wX wY A B - 2 * a * rectSum f wX wY S T
        + a ^ 2 * (finsetMass wX S * finsetMass wY T)
proof:
:= by
  have hpt : ∀ x y, (f x y - a * rectIndicator S T x y) ^ 2
      = f x y ^ 2 - 2 * a * (f x y * rectIndicator S T x y) + a ^ 2 * rectIndicator S T x y := by
    intro x y
    rw [rectIndicator_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [rectSqMass, rectSqMass]
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [rectSum_add, rectSum_sub, rectSum_smul, rectSum_smul, rectSum_mul_rectIndicator f hS hT,
    rectSum_rectIndicator, Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hS, Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hT]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_sub_rectAverage_smul_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSqMass_sub_rectAverage_smul_rectIndicator (f : RectKernel α β) (hS : S ⊆ A)
    (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    rectSqMass (fun x y => f x y - rectAverage f wX wY S T * rectIndicator S T x y) wX wY A B
      = rectSqMass f wX wY A B - rectBlockEnergy f wX wY S T
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSqMass_sub_smul_rectIndicator f hS hT, rectBlockEnergy]
  rcases eq_or_ne (finsetMass wX S * finsetMass wY T) 0 with h0 | h0
  · rw [rectAverage, h0, div_zero]
    ring
  · have hc : rectAverage f wX wY S T * (finsetMass wX S * finsetMass wY T)
        = rectSum f wX wY S T := by
      rw [rectAverage]
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0
    rw [← hc]
    ring

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem densityOn_empty : densityOn (∅ : Finset β) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [densityOn]

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_nonneg
statement: theorem densityOn_nonneg : 0 ≤ densityOn S p
proof:
:= by
  unfold densityOn; positivity

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_le_one
statement: theorem densityOn_le_one : densityOn S p ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · rw [densityOn, div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast S.card_pos.mpr hS)]
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_le S p

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_add_not
statement:
theorem densityOn_add_not (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    densityOn S p + densityOn S (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast S.card_pos.mpr hS
  rw [densityOn, densityOn, ← add_div, div_eq_one_iff_eq hcard.ne']
  exact_mod_cast S.card_filter_add_card_filter_not p

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_not
statement:
theorem densityOn_not (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    densityOn S (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1 - densityOn S p
proof:
:= by
  have := densityOn_add_not (p := p) hS
  linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_mono_pred
statement: theorem densityOn_mono_pred (h : ∀ x ∈ S, p x → q x) : densityOn S p ≤ densityOn S q
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · have hsub : S.filter p ⊆ S.filter q := fun x hx => by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
      exact ⟨hx.1, h x hx.1 hx.2⟩
    have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast S.card_pos.mpr hS
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub) hcard.le

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_densityOn_sub_densityOn_le
statement: theorem abs_densityOn_sub_densityOn_le :
proof:
|densityOn S p - densityOn S q| ≤ densityOn S fun x => ¬(p x ↔ q x) := by
  classical
  have key : ∀ (p' q' : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p'] [DecidablePred q'],
      densityOn S p' - densityOn S q' ≤ densityOn S fun x => ¬(p' x ↔ q' x) := by
    intro p' q' _ _
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
    · simp
    · have hsub : S.filter p'
          ⊆ (S.filter q') ∪ (S.filter fun x => ¬(p' x ↔ q' x)) := by
        intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
        rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
        by_cases hq : q' x
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1, hq⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hx.1, fun hiff => hq (hiff.mp hx.2)⟩
      have hcardle : ((S.filter p').card : ℝ) ≤ ((S.filter q').card : ℝ)
          + ((S.filter fun x => ¬(p' x ↔ q' x)).card : ℝ) := by
        have := le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (Finset.card_union_le _ _)
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast S.card_pos.mpr hS
      have hle : densityOn S p'
          ≤ densityOn S q' + densityOn S fun x => ¬(p' x ↔ q' x) := by
        rw [densityOn, densityOn, densityOn, ← add_div]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcardle hcard.le
      linarith
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  refine ⟨key p q, ?_⟩
  have hfilter : (S.filter fun x => ¬(q x ↔ p x))
      = (S.filter fun x => ¬(p x ↔ q x)) :=
    Finset.filter_congr fun x _ => by tauto
  have hcongr : (densityOn S fun x => ¬(q x ↔ p x))
      = densityOn S fun x => ¬(p x ↔ q x) := by
    rw [densityOn, densityOn, hfilter]
  rw [← hcongr]
  exact key q p

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_mul_card
statement:
theorem densityOn_mul_card (S : Finset β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    densityOn S p * (S.card : ℝ) = ((S.filter p).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · rw [densityOn, div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact_mod_cast (S.card_pos.mpr hS).ne'

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_densityOn_mul_card
statement:
theorem sq_densityOn_mul_card (S : Finset β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    densityOn S p ^ 2 * (S.card : ℝ) = ((S.filter p).card : ℝ) ^ 2 / (S.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · have hc : ((S.card : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (S.card_pos.mpr hS).ne'
    rw [densityOn, div_pow]
    field_simp

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_mono_subset
statement:
theorem card_filter_mono_subset (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (h : S ⊆ T) :
    (S.filter p).card ≤ (T.filter p).card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter p h)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_le_of_densityOn_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_of_densityOn_le (h : densityOn S p ≤ c) :
    ((S.filter p).card : ℝ) ≤ c * S.card
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast S.card_pos.mpr hS
    calc ((S.filter p).card : ℝ) = densityOn S p * S.card := by
          rw [densityOn, div_mul_cancel₀]; exact hcard.ne'
      _ ≤ c * S.card := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hcard.le

name: RegularityLemmata.le_card_filter_of_le_densityOn
statement:
theorem le_card_filter_of_le_densityOn (h : c ≤ densityOn S p) :
    c * S.card ≤ ((S.filter p).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · simp
  · have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast S.card_pos.mpr hS
    calc c * S.card ≤ densityOn S p * S.card := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hcard.le
      _ = ((S.filter p).card : ℝ) := by rw [densityOn, div_mul_cancel₀]; exact hcard.ne'

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_count_div
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_eq_count_div :
    tupleDensity R A = (tupleCount R A : ℝ) / (Fintype.piFinset A).card
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_nonneg
statement: theorem tupleDensity_nonneg : 0 ≤ tupleDensity R A
proof: := densityOn_nonneg

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_le_one
statement: theorem tupleDensity_le_one : tupleDensity R A ≤ 1
proof: := densityOn_le_one

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_add_neg
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_add_neg (hne : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) :
    tupleDensity R A + tupleDensity (fun x => ¬ R x) A = 1
proof:
:=
  densityOn_add_not (Fintype.piFinset_nonempty.mpr hne)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_neg
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_neg (hne : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) :
    tupleDensity (fun x => ¬ R x) A = 1 - tupleDensity R A
proof:
:=
  densityOn_not (Fintype.piFinset_nonempty.mpr hne)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le {c : ℝ} (h : tupleDensity R A ≤ c) :
    (tupleCount R A : ℝ) ≤ c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have := card_filter_le_of_densityOn_le h
  rwa [Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod] at this

name: RegularityLemmata.le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity
statement:
theorem le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity {c : ℝ} (h : c ≤ tupleDensity R A) :
    c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have := le_card_filter_of_le_densityOn h
  rwa [Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod] at this

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_eq_tupleDensity_mul
statement:
theorem tupleCount_eq_tupleDensity_mul :
    (tupleCount R A : ℝ) = tupleDensity R A * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le le_rfl)
    (le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity le_rfl)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_le_card
statement: theorem tupleCount_le_card : tupleCount R A ≤ (Fintype.piFinset A).card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_filter_le _ _

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_add_neg
statement:
theorem tupleCount_add_neg :
    tupleCount R A + tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A = (Fintype.piFinset A).card
proof:
:=
  (Fintype.piFinset A).card_filter_add_card_filter_not R

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_mono
statement: theorem tupleCount_mono (h : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i) : tupleCount R A' ≤ tupleCount R A
proof:
:=
  card_filter_mono_subset R (Fintype.piFinset_subset _ _ h)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty (h : Fintype.piFinset A = ∅) :
    tupleDensity R A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleDensity, h, densityOn_empty]

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty
statement: theorem tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) : tupleDensity R A = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp fun hne => ?_)
  exact (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mpr hi) (Fintype.piFinset_nonempty.mp hne i)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_one_eq
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_one_eq {A : Fin 1 → Finset α} {R : (Fin 1 → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred R] :
    tupleDensity R A = densityOn (A 0) fun a ↦ R ![a]
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleDensity, densityOn, densityOn, card_filter_piFinset_one, card_piFinset_one]

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_two_eq
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_two_eq :
    tupleDensity R₂ A₂ =
      (((A₂ 0 ×ˢ A₂ 1).filter fun p => R₂ ![p.1, p.2]).card : ℝ)
        / (((A₂ 0).card : ℝ) * (A₂ 1).card)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleDensity, densityOn, card_filter_piFinset_two, card_piFinset_two]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_product_le_of_tupleDensity_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_product_le_of_tupleDensity_le {c : ℝ} (h : tupleDensity R₂ A₂ ≤ c) :
    (((A₂ 0 ×ˢ A₂ 1).filter fun p => R₂ ![p.1, p.2]).card : ℝ)
      ≤ c * (((A₂ 0).card : ℝ) * (A₂ 1).card)
proof:
:= by
  have := card_filter_le_of_densityOn_le h
  rwa [card_filter_piFinset_two, card_piFinset_two, Nat.cast_mul] at this

name: RegularityLemmata.le_card_filter_product_of_le_tupleDensity
statement:
theorem le_card_filter_product_of_le_tupleDensity {c : ℝ} (h : c ≤ tupleDensity R₂ A₂) :
    c * (((A₂ 0).card : ℝ) * (A₂ 1).card)
      ≤ (((A₂ 0 ×ˢ A₂ 1).filter fun p => R₂ ![p.1, p.2]).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have := le_card_filter_of_le_densityOn h
  rwa [card_filter_piFinset_two, card_piFinset_two, Nat.cast_mul] at this

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_unionTuples
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_unionTuples [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {F : Finset (FiniteBox V)} {x : ∀ i, V i} :
    x ∈ unionTuples F ↔ ∃ A ∈ F, x ∈ A.tuples
proof: := Finset.mem_biUnion

name: RegularityLemmata.unionTuples_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionTuples_empty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] :
    unionTuples (∅ : Finset (FiniteBox V)) = ∅
proof: := Finset.biUnion_empty

name: RegularityLemmata.unionTuples_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionTuples_singleton [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (A : FiniteBox V) : unionTuples {A} = A.tuples
proof: := Finset.singleton_biUnion

name: RegularityLemmata.unionTuples_subset
statement:
theorem unionTuples_subset [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)} (h : F ⊆ G) : unionTuples F ⊆ unionTuples G
proof:
:=
  Finset.biUnion_subset_biUnion_of_subset_left _ h

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_eq_finsetMass_tupleWeight
statement:
theorem boxMass_eq_finsetMass_tupleWeight [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxMass w A = finsetMass (tupleWeight w) A.tuples
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_unionTuples_of_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem finsetMass_unionTuples_of_pairwiseDisjoint [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) {F : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (h : (F : Set (FiniteBox V)).PairwiseDisjoint FiniteBox.tuples) :
    finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F) = ∑ A ∈ F, boxMass w A
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_biUnion h

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_unionTuples_le
statement:
theorem finsetMass_unionTuples_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ unionTuples F, 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F) ≤ ∑ A ∈ F, boxMass w A
proof:
:=
  finsetMass_biUnion_le hw

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_apply
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_apply [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)) :
    boxUnionError w F G = finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_comm
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_comm [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)) :
    boxUnionError w F G = boxUnionError w G F
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxUnionError, boxUnionError, symmDiff_comm]

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxUnionError_self [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (F : Finset (FiniteBox V)) : boxUnionError w F F = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxUnionError, symmDiff_self]
  exact finsetMass_empty _

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_of_unionTuples_eq
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_of_unionTuples_eq [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)} (h : unionTuples F = unionTuples G) :
    boxUnionError w F G = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxUnionError, h, symmDiff_self]
  exact finsetMass_empty _

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_nonneg
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_nonneg [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G, 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    0 ≤ boxUnionError w F G
proof: := finsetMass_nonneg hw

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_triangle
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_triangle [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F G H : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ (unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G) ∪ (unionTuples G ∆ unionTuples H),
      0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    boxUnionError w F H ≤ boxUnionError w F G + boxUnionError w G H
proof:
:=
  le_trans (finsetMass_mono hw (symmDiff_triangle _ _ _)) (finsetMass_union_le hw)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sub_finsetMass_unionTuples_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_finsetMass_unionTuples_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G, 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    |finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F)
        - finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples G)| ≤ boxUnionError w F G
proof:
:=
  abs_sub_finsetMass_le hw

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_le_sum_of_exists_mem
statement:
theorem sum_le_sum_of_exists_mem {γ κ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype κ]
    (S : Finset γ) (T : κ → Finset γ) (f : γ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hcov : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ k, x ∈ T k) :
    ∑ x ∈ S, f x ≤ ∑ k, ∑ x ∈ T k, f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc ∑ x ∈ S, f x
      ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ k : κ, (if x ∈ T k then f x else 0) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => ?_
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcov x hx
        have hterm : f x = (if x ∈ T k then f x else 0) := by rw [ite_eq_left hk]
        refine le_trans (le_of_eq hterm) (Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun k => if x ∈ T k then f x else 0)
          (fun k _ => by by_cases h : x ∈ T k <;> simp [h, hf x]) (Finset.mem_univ k))
    _ = ∑ k : κ, ∑ x ∈ S, (if x ∈ T k then f x else 0) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ k : κ, ∑ x ∈ T k, f x := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.inter_subset_right
          fun x _ _ => hf x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_event_mass_le_of_weight_floor
statement:
theorem sum_event_mass_le_of_weight_floor {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Bad : E → Finset (β × β))
    {w₀ : ℝ} (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hW : ∀ j, w₀ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      ≤ (∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2) / w₀ ^ 2
        * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set W : ι → ℝ := fun j => ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x with hWdef
  have hWpos : ∀ j, 0 < W j := fun j => lt_of_lt_of_le hw₀ (hW j)
  rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => ?_
  have hmass : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => mul_nonneg (hwt _) (hwt _)
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  have hmem₂ : i₂ e ∈ Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e) :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(hne e).symm, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hsplit : W (i₁ e) * (W (i₂ e) * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), W j)
      = ∏ j, W j := by
    rw [Finset.mul_prod_erase _ W hmem₂, Finset.mul_prod_erase _ W (Finset.mem_univ (i₁ e))]
  have hrest : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), W j :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => (hWpos j).le
  have hbound : ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), W j ≤ (∏ j, W j) / w₀ ^ 2 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    calc (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), W j) * w₀ ^ 2
        ≤ (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), W j) * (W (i₁ e) * W (i₂ e)) := by
          have := mul_le_mul (hW (i₁ e)) (hW (i₂ e)) hw₀.le (hWpos (i₁ e)).le
          nlinarith [hrest]
      _ = ∏ j, W j := by rw [← hsplit]; ring
  calc (∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2)
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), W j
      ≤ (∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2) * ((∏ j, W j) / w₀ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound hmass
    _ = (∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2) / w₀ ^ 2 * ∏ j, W j := by
        ring

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le_of_weight_floor
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le_of_weight_floor {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Dev : E → Finset (β × β))
    {w₀ A : ℝ} (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hW : ∀ j, w₀ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hagg : ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2 ≤ A) :
    ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ A / w₀ ^ 2 * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => hwt x
  rw [sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost t wt i₁ i₂ hne Dev (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))]
  simp only [one_mul]
  refine le_trans (sum_event_mass_le_of_weight_floor t wt hwt i₁ i₂ hne Dev hw₀ hW) ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hagg (by positivity)) hprod

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectSum_empty_left (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (B : Finset Y) : rectSum f wX wY ∅ B = 0
proof:
:= by

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_empty_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectSum_empty_right (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) : rectSum f wX wY A ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectSum_zero (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ)) wX wY A B = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y _ => mul_zero _

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_const
statement:
theorem rectSum_const (c : ℝ) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun _ _ => c) wX wY A B = c * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, finsetMass, finsetMass, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_add
statement:
theorem rectSum_add (f g : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun x y => f x y + g x y) wX wY A B
      = rectSum f wX wY A B + rectSum g wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, rectSum, rectSum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_neg
statement:
theorem rectSum_neg (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun x y => -f x y) wX wY A B = -rectSum f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, rectSum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_sub
statement:
theorem rectSum_sub (f g : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun x y => f x y - g x y) wX wY A B
      = rectSum f wX wY A B - rectSum g wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, rectSum, rectSum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_smul
statement:
theorem rectSum_smul (c : ℝ) (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun x y => c * f x y) wX wY A B = c * rectSum f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, rectSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectSum_smul_weight_left (c : ℝ) (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum f (fun x => c * wX x) wY A B = c * rectSum f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSum, rectSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectAverage_smul_weight_left {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectAverage f (fun x => c * wX x) wY A B = rectAverage f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectAverage, rectAverage, rectSum_smul_weight_left, finsetMass_smul,
    show c * finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B
      = c * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) from by ring]
  rcases eq_or_ne (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) 0 with h | h
  · rw [h, mul_zero, div_zero, div_zero]
  · rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hc]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_finset_sum
statement:
theorem rectSum_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (h : ι → RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectSum (fun x y => ∑ k ∈ s, h k x y) wX wY A B = ∑ k ∈ s, rectSum (h k) wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hinner : ∀ x, (∑ y ∈ B, ∑ k ∈ s, wX x * wY y * h k x y)
      = ∑ k ∈ s, ∑ y ∈ B, wX x * wY y * h k x y := fun x => Finset.sum_comm
  simp only [hinner]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

statement:
theorem rectSum_op (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)

    rectSum f.op wY wX B A = rectSum f wX wY A B

    rectAverage f.op wY wX B A = rectAverage f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.IsIccBoundedOnRectangle.absBounded
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy => by
  have := h x hx y hy
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at this
  rw [abs_le]
  exact ⟨by linarith [this.1], by linarith [this.2]⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectSum_nonneg (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ f x y) : 0 ≤ rectSum f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun x hx => Finset.sum_nonneg fun y hy =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy)) (hf x hx y hy)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectAverage_nonneg (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ f x y) : 0 ≤ rectAverage f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (rectSum_nonneg hwX hwY hf)
    (mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY))

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectSum_le
statement:
theorem abs_rectSum_le {C : ℝ} (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f C A B) :
    |rectSum f wX wY A B| ≤ C * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rectSum_const C wX wY A B]
  refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
  rw [rectSum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun y hy => ?_
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy))]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf x hx y hy) (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy))

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectAverage_le
statement:
theorem abs_rectAverage_le {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) (hf : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f C A B) :
    |rectAverage f wX wY A B| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 ≤ finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B :=
    mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hm with h | h
  · rw [rectAverage, ← h, div_zero, abs_zero]
    exact hC
  · rw [rectAverage, abs_div, abs_of_pos h, div_le_iff₀ h]
    exact abs_rectSum_le hwX hwY hf

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_mem_unitInterval
statement:
theorem rectAverage_mem_unitInterval (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsUnitIntervalOnRectangle f A B) :
    rectAverage f wX wY A B ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have habs : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f 1 A B :=
    hf.absBounded (by norm_num) le_rfl
  refine Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact rectAverage_nonneg hwX hwY fun x hx y hy => (Set.mem_Icc.mp (hf x hx y hy)).1
  · have := abs_rectAverage_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) hwX hwY habs
    exact (abs_le.mp this).2

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_const
statement:
theorem rectAverage_const (c : ℝ) (hA : 0 < finsetMass wX A) (hB : 0 < finsetMass wY B) :
    rectAverage (fun _ _ => c) wX wY A B = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectAverage, rectSum_const, mul_div_assoc, div_self (by positivity), mul_one]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem rectAverage_mem_Icc {a b : ℝ} (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hA : 0 < finsetMass wX A) (hB : 0 < finsetMass wY B)
    (hf : IsIccBoundedOnRectangle f a b A B) :
    rectAverage f wX wY A B ∈ Set.Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 < finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B := mul_pos hA hB
  have hlow : a * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) ≤ rectSum f wX wY A B := by
    rw [← rectSum_const a wX wY A B, rectSum, rectSum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y hy => ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Set.mem_Icc.mp (hf x hx y hy)).1
      (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy))
  have hhigh : rectSum f wX wY A B ≤ b * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) := by
    rw [← rectSum_const b wX wY A B, rectSum, rectSum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y hy => ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Set.mem_Icc.mp (hf x hx y hy)).2
      (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy))
  rw [rectAverage, Set.mem_Icc, le_div_iff₀ hm, div_le_iff₀ hm]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rectSum_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B)
    (h : finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B = 0) : rectSum f wX wY S T = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with hA | hB
  · have hz : ∀ x ∈ A, wX x = 0 := fun x hx =>
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hwX).mp hA x hx
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y _ => by
      rw [hz x (hS hx), zero_mul, zero_mul]
  · have hz : ∀ y ∈ B, wY y = 0 := fun y hy =>
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hwY).mp hB y hy
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y hy => by
      rw [hz y (hT hy), mul_zero, zero_mul]

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_mul_pos_of_lt_abs_rectSum
statement:
theorem finsetMass_mul_pos_of_lt_abs_rectSum (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) {ε : ℝ}
    (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectSum f wX wY S T|) :
    0 < finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY)) with h | h
  · exfalso
    rw [← h, mul_zero, rectSum_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero hwX hwY hS hT h.symm,
      abs_zero] at hwit
    exact lt_irrefl _ hwit
  · exact h

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_def
statement:
theorem rectSqMass_def :
    rectSqMass f wX wY A B = ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ y ∈ B, wX x * wY y * f x y ^ 2
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectSqMass_nonneg (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    0 ≤ rectSqMass f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  rectSum_nonneg hwX hwY fun _ _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSqMass, ← rectSum_const (C ^ 2) wX wY A B, rectSum, rectSum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y hy => ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy))
  have := hf x hx y hy
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (f x y), sq_abs (f x y), abs_le.mp this]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_op
statement: theorem rectSqMass_op : rectSqMass f.op wY wX B A = rectSqMass f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  rectSum_op _ wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_nonneg (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    0 ≤ rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
    (mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY))

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_le_mass
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_le_mass (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) :
    rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B ≤ finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B
proof:
:= by
  have habs := abs_rectAverage_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) hwX hwY hf
  have hsq : rectAverage f wX wY A B ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp habs
    nlinarith [this.1, this.2]
  calc rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B
      ≤ 1 * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq
          (mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY))
    _ = finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B := one_mul _

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_op
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_op (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectBlockEnergy f.op wY wX B A = rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectBlockEnergy, rectBlockEnergy, rectAverage_op, mul_comm (finsetMass wY B)]

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_mono
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectSqMass, rectSqMass, rectSum, rectSum]
  calc ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ T, wX x * wY y * f x y ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ B, wX x * wY y * f x y ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hT fun y hy _ =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hwX x (hS hx)) (hwY y hy)) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ y ∈ B, wX x * wY y * f x y ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hS fun x hx _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun y hy =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hwX x hx) (hwY y hy)) (sq_nonneg _)

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_rectSum_le_mul_rectSqMass
statement:
theorem sq_rectSum_le_mul_rectSqMass (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectSum f wX wY A B ^ 2 ≤ (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) * rectSqMass f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := sq_sum_mul_le_sum_mul_sum_sq_mul (fun p : X × Y => f p.1 p.2)
    (fun p => wX p.1 * wY p.2) (A ×ˢ B) fun p hp =>
      mul_nonneg (hwX p.1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1) (hwY p.2 (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2)
  have e1 : ∑ p ∈ A ×ˢ B, f p.1 p.2 * (wX p.1 * wY p.2) = rectSum f wX wY A B := by
    rw [rectSum, Finset.sum_product]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
  have e2 : ∑ p ∈ A ×ˢ B, wX p.1 * wY p.2 = finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B := by
    rw [finsetMass, finsetMass, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_product]
  have e3 : ∑ p ∈ A ×ˢ B, f p.1 p.2 ^ 2 * (wX p.1 * wY p.2) = rectSqMass f wX wY A B := by
    rw [rectSqMass, rectSum, Finset.sum_product]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
  rwa [e1, e2, e3] at h

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_le_rectSqMass
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_le_rectSqMass (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B ≤ rectSqMass f wX wY A B
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B :=
    mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hd0 with h0 | hpos
  · rw [rectBlockEnergy, ← h0, mul_zero]
    exact rectSqMass_nonneg hwX hwY
  · have hcs := sq_rectSum_le_mul_rectSqMass (f := f) hwX hwY
    rw [rectBlockEnergy, rectAverage, div_pow, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [hcs, hpos]

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectAverage_le_inv_of_lt_abs_rectSum
statement:
theorem abs_rectAverage_le_inv_of_lt_abs_rectSum (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectSum f wX wY S T|)
    (hsq : rectSqMass f wX wY A B ≤ finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) :
    |rectAverage f wX wY S T| ≤ 1 / ε
proof:
:= by
  have hwS : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ wX x := fun x hx => hwX x (hS hx)
  have hwT : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ wY y := fun y hy => hwY y (hT hy)
  set M := finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B with hM
  set d := finsetMass wX S * finsetMass wY T with hd
  set c := rectAverage f wX wY S T with hc
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwX) (finsetMass_nonneg hwY)
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (mul_nonneg (finsetMass_nonneg hwS) (finsetMass_nonneg hwT)) with
      h0 | h
    · exfalso
      rw [rectSum_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero hwS hwT (Finset.Subset.refl S)
        (Finset.Subset.refl T) h0.symm, abs_zero] at hwit
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε.le hM0]
    · exact h
  have hcd : |c| * d = |rectSum f wX wY S T| := by
    rw [hc, rectAverage, ← hd, abs_div, abs_of_pos hdpos, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdpos.ne']
  
  
  have hcM : |c| ^ 2 * d ≤ M := by
    rw [sq_abs]
    exact (rectBlockEnergy_le_rectSqMass (f := f) hwS hwT).trans
      ((rectSqMass_mono hwX hwY hS hT).trans hsq)
  have h1 : ε * M < |c| * d := by rw [hcd]; exact hwit
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hε]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (abs_nonneg c) with hc0 | hcpos
  · rw [← hc0, zero_mul]; exact zero_le_one
  · have h3 : ε * |c| * (|c| * d) < 1 * (|c| * d) := by
      calc ε * |c| * (|c| * d) = ε * (|c| ^ 2 * d) := by ring
        _ ≤ ε * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcM hε.le
        _ < |c| * d := h1
        _ = 1 * (|c| * d) := (one_mul _).symm
    have := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h3 (mul_pos hcpos hdpos).le
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_forward_monochromatic_chain
statement:
theorem exists_forward_monochromatic_chain (χ : V → V → Fin r) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (S : Finset V), (r + 1) ^ t ≤ S.card →
    ∃ (v : Fin t → V) (c : Fin t → Fin r),
      (∀ i, v i ∈ S) ∧ Function.Injective v ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin t, i < j → χ (v i) (v j) = c i
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro S _
    exact ⟨Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    intro S hS
    have hpos : 0 < S.card :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos r)) hS
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpos
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr0 | hrpos
    · subst hr0
      exact (χ x x).elim0
    
    have hclass : (univ : Finset (Fin r)).card * (r + 1) ^ t ≤ (S.erase x).card := by
      rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx]
      have h2 : r * (r + 1) ^ t + 1 ≤ (r + 1) ^ (t + 1) := by
        have h3 := Nat.one_le_pow t (r + 1) (Nat.succ_pos r)
        have h5 : (r + 1) ^ (t + 1) = r * (r + 1) ^ t + (r + 1) ^ t := by ring
        omega
      have h4 : r * (r + 1) ^ t + 1 ≤ S.card := le_trans h2 hS
      omega
    obtain ⟨c₀, -, hc₀⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_le_card_fiber_of_mul_le_card_of_maps_to
        (f := χ x) (fun a _ => mem_univ _)
        (univ_nonempty_iff.mpr ⟨⟨0, hrpos⟩⟩) hclass
    obtain ⟨v', c', hv'mem, hv'inj, hv'chain⟩ :=
      ih ((S.erase x).filter (fun y => χ x y = c₀)) hc₀
    
    refine ⟨Fin.cons x v', Fin.cons c₀ c', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
      · simpa using hx
      · rw [Fin.cons_succ]
        exact Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_filter _ (hv'mem i'))
    · intro a b hab
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ a with rfl | ⟨a', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ b with rfl | ⟨b', rfl⟩
      · rfl
      · rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ] at hab
        exact absurd hab.symm (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase
          (Finset.mem_of_mem_filter _ (hv'mem b')))
      · rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero] at hab
        exact absurd hab (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase
          (Finset.mem_of_mem_filter _ (hv'mem a')))
      · rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ] at hab
        rw [hv'inj hab]
    · intro i j hij
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
      · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
        · exact absurd hij (lt_irrefl _)
        · simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
          exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hv'mem j')).2
      · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
        · exact absurd hij (Fin.not_lt_zero _)
        · simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
          exact hv'chain i' j' (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_monochromatic_subchain
statement:
theorem exists_monochromatic_subchain (χ : V → V → Fin r) {s : ℕ} (S : Finset V)
    (hS : multicolorRamseyBound r s ≤ S.card) :
    ∃ (v : Fin s → V) (c : Fin r), (∀ i, v i ∈ S) ∧ Function.Injective v ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin s, i < j → χ (v i) (v j) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w, cw, hwS, hwinj, hwchain⟩ :=
    exists_forward_monochromatic_chain χ (r * s + 1) S hS
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr0 | hrpos
  · subst hr0
    exact (χ (w ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩) (w ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩)).elim0
  
  have hcnt : (univ : Finset (Fin r)).card * s
      < (univ : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1))).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  obtain ⟨c₀, -, hc₀⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to
      (f := cw) (fun a _ => mem_univ _) hcnt
  set T := (univ : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1))).filter (fun a => cw a = c₀) with hT
  have hTcard : s ≤ T.card := le_of_lt hc₀
  
  refine ⟨fun i => w ((T.orderIsoOfFin rfl ⟨i.1, lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hTcard⟩ : T) : _),
    c₀, fun i => hwS _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    have h1 := hwinj hab
    have h2 := (T.orderIsoOfFin rfl).injective (Subtype.ext h1)
    have h3 := congrArg Fin.val h2
    exact Fin.ext h3
  · intro i j hij
    have hmono : (T.orderIsoOfFin rfl ⟨i.1, lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hTcard⟩ : T)
        < T.orderIsoOfFin rfl ⟨j.1, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hTcard⟩ :=
      (T.orderIsoOfFin rfl).strictMono (by exact_mod_cast hij)
    have hfib : cw ((T.orderIsoOfFin rfl ⟨i.1, lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hTcard⟩ : T) : _)
        = c₀ :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp
        (T.orderIsoOfFin rfl ⟨i.1, lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hTcard⟩).2).2
    rw [← hfib]
    exact hwchain _ _ hmono

name: RegularityLemmata.fin_two_cases
statement: private theorem fin_two_cases (c : Fin 2) : c = 0 ∨ c = 1
proof: := by revert c; decide

name: RegularityLemmata.ramsey_aux
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro a b hab color
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by omega
      
      have hroot : ∀ x : InternalNode 1, x = root 0 := by
        intro x
        rcases internalNode_cases x with h | ⟨_, y, _⟩
        · exact h
        · exact absurd y.2 (by omega)
      rcases fin_two_cases (color (root 0)) with hc | hc
      · exact Or.inl ⟨InternalEmbedding.id 1, fun x => by rw [id_apply, hroot x]; exact hc⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨InternalEmbedding.id 1, fun x => by rw [id_apply, hroot x]; exact hc⟩
  | succ m ih =>
      intro a b hab color
      
      
      have hfork : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (F G : InternalEmbedding k (m + 1 + 1))
          (hf : ∀ y, BranchBelow false (root (m + 1)).1 (F y).1)
          (hg : ∀ y, BranchBelow true (root (m + 1)).1 (G y).1),
          color (root (m + 1)) = c → (∀ y, color (F y) = c) → (∀ y, color (G y) = c) →
          ∀ z, color (fork (root (m + 1)) F G hf hg z) = c := by
        intro k c F G hf hg hr hF hG z
        rcases internalNode_cases z with rfl | ⟨d, y, rfl⟩
        · rw [fork_root]; exact hr
        · rw [fork_cons]; cases d
          · simpa using hF y
          · simpa using hG y
      rcases a with _ | a' <;> rcases b with _ | b'
      · omega
      · 
        obtain rfl : b' = m := by omega
        by_cases hex : ∃ x, color x = 0
        · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hex
          exact Or.inl ⟨singleton x, fun y => by rw [singleton_apply]; exact hx⟩
        · push Not at hex
          refine Or.inr ⟨InternalEmbedding.id _, fun x => ?_⟩
          rw [id_apply]
          rcases fin_two_cases (color x) with hc | hc
          · exact absurd hc (hex x)
          · exact hc
      · 
        obtain rfl : a' = m := by omega
        by_cases hex : ∃ x, color x = 1
        · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hex
          exact Or.inr ⟨singleton x, fun y => by rw [singleton_apply]; exact hx⟩
        · push Not at hex
          refine Or.inl ⟨InternalEmbedding.id _, fun x => ?_⟩
          rw [id_apply]
          rcases fin_two_cases (color x) with hc | hc
          · exact hc
          · exact absurd hc (hex x)
      · 
        rcases fin_two_cases (color (root (m + 1))) with hr | hr
        · 
          have hstep : ∀ d : Bool,
              (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (a' + 1) (m + 1),
                ∀ x, color (consInternal d (e x)) = 0) ∨
              (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (b' + 1 + 1) (m + 1),
                ∀ x, color (consInternal d (e x)) = 1) :=
            fun d => ih a' (b' + 1) (by omega) (fun y => color (consInternal d y))
          rcases hstep false with ⟨ef, hef⟩ | ⟨e, he⟩
          · rcases hstep true with ⟨eg, heg⟩ | ⟨e, he⟩
            · refine Or.inl ⟨fork (root (m + 1))
                (comp (branchLift (m + 1) false) ef) (comp (branchLift (m + 1) true) eg)
                (fun y => branchBelow_root_branchLift (m + 1) false (ef y))
                (fun y => branchBelow_root_branchLift (m + 1) true (eg y)), ?_⟩
              exact hfork _ 0 _ _ _ _ hr hef heg
            · exact Or.inr ⟨comp (branchLift (m + 1) true) e, he⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨comp (branchLift (m + 1) false) e, he⟩
        · 
          have hstep : ∀ d : Bool,
              (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (a' + 1 + 1) (m + 1),
                ∀ x, color (consInternal d (e x)) = 0) ∨
              (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (b' + 1) (m + 1),
                ∀ x, color (consInternal d (e x)) = 1) :=
            fun d => ih (a' + 1) b' (by omega) (fun y => color (consInternal d y))
          rcases hstep false with ⟨e, he⟩ | ⟨ef, hef⟩
          · exact Or.inl ⟨comp (branchLift (m + 1) false) e, he⟩
          · rcases hstep true with ⟨e, he⟩ | ⟨eg, heg⟩
            · exact Or.inl ⟨comp (branchLift (m + 1) true) e, he⟩
            · refine Or.inr ⟨fork (root (m + 1))
                (comp (branchLift (m + 1) false) ef) (comp (branchLift (m + 1) true) eg)
                (fun y => branchBelow_root_branchLift (m + 1) false (ef y))
                (fun y => branchBelow_root_branchLift (m + 1) true (eg y)), ?_⟩
              exact hfork _ 1 _ _ _ _ hr hef heg

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_two
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_two (a b : ℕ) (color : BinaryTreeTwoColoring (a + b + 1)) :
    (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (a + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e x) = 0) ∨
    (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (b + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e x) = 1)
proof:
:=
  ramsey_aux (a + b) a b rfl color

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_two_proper
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_two_proper (a b : ℕ) (color : BinaryTreeTwoColoring (a + b + 1)) :
    (∃ e : ProperEmbedding (a + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = 0) ∨
    (∃ e : ProperEmbedding (b + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases binaryTreeRamsey_two a b color with ⟨e, he⟩ | ⟨e, he⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨extendProper e, he⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨extendProper e, he⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.ramsey_aux_multi
statement:
private theorem ramsey_aux_multi : ∀ (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (t : Fin m → ℕ), ∑ i, t i = n →
    ∀ color : InternalNode (n + 1) → Fin m,
    ∃ (i : Fin m) (k : ℕ), k = t i + 1 ∧
      ∃ e : InternalEmbedding k (n + 1), ∀ x, color (e x) = i
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro m t hsum color
      have hroot : ∀ x : InternalNode 1, x = root 0 := by
        intro x
        rcases internalNode_cases x with h | ⟨_, y, _⟩
        · exact h
        · exact absurd y.2 (by omega)
      
      have htc : t (color (root 0)) = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hsum) _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
      exact ⟨color (root 0), 1, by omega, InternalEmbedding.id 1,
        fun x => by rw [id_apply, hroot x]⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro m t hsum color
      have hfork : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : Fin m) (F G : InternalEmbedding k (n + 1 + 1))
          (hf : ∀ y, BranchBelow false (root (n + 1)).1 (F y).1)
          (hg : ∀ y, BranchBelow true (root (n + 1)).1 (G y).1),
          color (root (n + 1)) = c → (∀ y, color (F y) = c) → (∀ y, color (G y) = c) →
          ∀ z, color (fork (root (n + 1)) F G hf hg z) = c := by
        intro k c F G hf hg hr hF hG z
        rcases internalNode_cases z with rfl | ⟨d, y, rfl⟩
        · rw [fork_root]; exact hr
        · rw [fork_cons]; cases d
          · simpa using hF y
          · simpa using hG y
      set c := color (root (n + 1)) with hc
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (t c) with h0 | hpos
      · 
        exact ⟨c, 1, by omega, singleton (root (n + 1)), fun y => by rw [singleton_apply]⟩
      · 
        obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ : ∃ t', t c = t' + 1 := ⟨t c - 1, by omega⟩
        set t'' := Function.update t c t' with ht''
        have hsum' : ∑ i, t'' i = n := by
          have h1 := Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ c) t (t c)
          rw [Function.update_eq_self] at h1
          have h2 := Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ c) t t'
          rw [ht'', h2]
          omega
        have hstep : ∀ d : Bool, ∃ (i : Fin m) (k : ℕ), k = t'' i + 1 ∧
            ∃ e : InternalEmbedding k (n + 1), ∀ x, color (consInternal d (e x)) = i :=
          fun d => ih t'' hsum' (fun y => color (consInternal d y))
        obtain ⟨i₀, k₀, hk₀, e₀, he₀⟩ := hstep false
        obtain ⟨i₁, k₁, hk₁, e₁, he₁⟩ := hstep true
        by_cases h₀ : i₀ = c
        · by_cases h₁ : i₁ = c
          · 
            have hk : k₀ = t' + 1 := by rw [hk₀, h₀, ht'', Function.update_self]
            have hk' : k₁ = t' + 1 := by rw [hk₁, h₁, ht'', Function.update_self]
            subst hk hk'
            exact ⟨c, t' + 1 + 1, by omega, fork (root (n + 1))
              (comp (branchLift (n + 1) false) e₀) (comp (branchLift (n + 1) true) e₁)
              (fun y => branchBelow_root_branchLift (n + 1) false (e₀ y))
              (fun y => branchBelow_root_branchLift (n + 1) true (e₁ y)),
              hfork _ c _ _ _ _ hc.symm (fun y => (he₀ y).trans h₀) (fun y => (he₁ y).trans h₁)⟩
          · 
            exact ⟨i₁, k₁, by rw [hk₁, ht'', Function.update_of_ne h₁],
              comp (branchLift (n + 1) true) e₁, he₁⟩
        · exact ⟨i₀, k₀, by rw [hk₀, ht'', Function.update_of_ne h₀],
            comp (branchLift (n + 1) false) e₀, he₀⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey (m : ℕ) (t : Fin m → ℕ)
    (color : InternalNode ((∑ i, t i) + 1) → Fin m) :
    ∃ (i : Fin m) (e : InternalEmbedding (t i + 1) ((∑ i, t i) + 1)),
      ∀ x, color (e x) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, k, hk, e, he⟩ := ramsey_aux_multi (∑ i, t i) t rfl color
  subst hk
  exact ⟨i, e, he⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_proper
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_proper (m : ℕ) (t : Fin m → ℕ)
    (color : InternalNode ((∑ i, t i) + 1) → Fin m) :
    ∃ (i : Fin m) (e : ProperEmbedding (t i + 1) ((∑ i, t i) + 1)),
      ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, e, he⟩ := binaryTreeRamsey m t color
  exact ⟨i, extendProper e, he⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_proper_const
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_proper_const (m t : ℕ) (color : InternalNode (m * t + 1) → Fin m) :
    ∃ (c : Fin m) (e : ProperEmbedding (t + 1) (m * t + 1)), ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, k, hk, e, he⟩ := ramsey_aux_multi (m * t) (fun _ : Fin m => t)
    (by simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]) color
  subst hk
  exact ⟨c, extendProper e, he⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_def
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_def [inst : DecidableRel R] :
    IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε ↔ pairDensity R A B ≤ ε ∨ 1 - ε ≤ pairDensity R A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsHomogeneousPair
  rw [show (fun a b => Classical.dec (R a b) : DecidableRel R) = inst from
    funext fun a => funext fun b => Subsingleton.elim _ _]

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousPair.mono
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousPair.mono (h : IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε) (hε : ε ≤ ε') :
    IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (h.trans hε)
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_swapRel_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_swapRel_iff :
    IsHomogeneousPair (swapRel R) B A ε ↔ IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def, isHomogeneousPair_def, pairDensity_swapRel]

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_not_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_not_iff :
    IsHomogeneousPair (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B ε ↔ IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hA | hA
  · subst hA
    rw [isHomogeneousPair_def, isHomogeneousPair_def, pairDensity_empty_left,
      pairDensity_empty_left]
  · rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hB | hB
    · subst hB
      rw [isHomogeneousPair_def, isHomogeneousPair_def, pairDensity_empty_right,
        pairDensity_empty_right]
    · rw [isHomogeneousPair_def, isHomogeneousPair_def, pairDensity_not hA hB]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
        · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
        · exact Or.inl (by linarith)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_restrict_le
statement:
theorem pairDensity_restrict_le {S : α → β → Prop} [DecidableRel S] {c ρA ρB : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hρA : 0 < ρA) (hρB : 0 < ρB) (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hAc : ρA * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ)) (hBc : ρB * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ))
    (hS : (pairCount S A B : ℝ) ≤ c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card) :
    pairDensity S A' B' ≤ c / (ρA * ρB)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : (0 : ℝ) < ρA * ρB := mul_pos hρA hρB
  have hmass' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) * B'.card := by positivity
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hmass' with hzero | hpos
  · rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, ← hzero, div_zero]
    positivity
  · 
    have hAp : (0 : ℝ) < (A'.card : ℝ) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) A'.card) with h | h
      · exfalso; rw [← h, zero_mul] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
      · exact h
    have hBp : (0 : ℝ) < (B'.card : ℝ) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) B'.card) with h | h
      · exfalso; rw [← h, mul_zero] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
      · exact h
    have hcount : (pairCount S A' B' : ℝ) ≤ c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card :=
      le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (pairCount_mono hA hB)) hS
    
    have hAn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hBn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (B.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hprod : (ρA * ρB) * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) * B'.card := by
      calc (ρA * ρB) * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card)
          = (ρA * (A.card : ℝ)) * (ρB * (B.card : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul hAc hBc (by positivity) (le_of_lt hAp)
    rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hpos hρ]
    calc (pairCount S A' B' : ℝ) * (ρA * ρB)
        ≤ (c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card) * (ρA * ρB) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hρ.le
      _ = c * ((ρA * ρB) * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card)) := by ring
      _ ≤ c * ((A'.card : ℝ) * B'.card) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod hc

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousPair.subset_zero
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousPair.subset_zero (h : IsHomogeneousPair R A B 0)
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) : IsHomogeneousPair R A' B' 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def] at h ⊢
  have hmass : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * B.card := by positivity
  rcases h with h | h
  · 
    left
    have hzero : (pairCount R A B : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
      rw [pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h hmass
    have hzero' : pairCount R A B = 0 := by
      have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (pairCount R A B)
      exact_mod_cast le_antisymm hzero this
    have : pairCount R A' B' = 0 :=
      Nat.le_zero.mp (hzero' ▸ pairCount_mono hA hB)
    rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, this]
    simp
  · 
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    have hall : (A.card : ℝ) * B.card ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ) := by
      rw [pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul]
      nlinarith [pairDensity_le_one (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)]
    have hnot : pairCount (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = 0 := by
      have hsum := pairCount_add_not (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
      have hle : (A.card : ℝ) * B.card ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ) := hall
      have : pairCount R A B = A.card * B.card := by
        have h1 : pairCount R A B ≤ A.card * B.card := by omega
        have h2 : A.card * B.card ≤ pairCount R A B := by exact_mod_cast hle
        omega
      omega
    have hnot' : pairCount (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A' B' = 0 :=
      Nat.le_zero.mp (hnot ▸ pairCount_mono (R := fun a b => ¬ R a b) hA hB)
    rcases A'.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hAe | hAe
    · left; rw [hAe, pairDensity_empty_left]
    rcases B'.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hBe | hBe
    · left; rw [hBe, pairDensity_empty_right]
    right
    rw [sub_zero]
    have hd : pairDensity (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A' B' = 0 := by
      rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, hnot']
      simp
    rw [pairDensity_not hAe hBe] at hd
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousPair.restrict
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousPair.restrict {ρA ρB : ℝ} (h : IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hρA : 0 < ρA) (hρB : 0 < ρB) (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hAc : ρA * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ)) (hBc : ρB * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ)) :
    IsHomogeneousPair R A' B' (ε / (ρA * ρB))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | h
  · left
    exact pairDensity_restrict_le hε hρA hρB hA hB hAc hBc
      (pairCount_le_of_pairDensity_le h)
  · 
    have hnotcount : (pairCount (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B : ℝ)
        ≤ ε * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card := by
      have hsum := pairCount_add_not (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
      have hR : (1 - ε) * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ) :=
        le_pairCount_of_le_pairDensity h
      have hcast : (pairCount R A B : ℝ) + (pairCount (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B : ℝ)
          = (A.card : ℝ) * B.card := by exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast (R := ℝ)) hsum
      nlinarith [hR, hcast]
    have hnotd : pairDensity (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A' B' ≤ ε / (ρA * ρB) :=
      pairDensity_restrict_le hε hρA hρB hA hB hAc hBc hnotcount
    rcases A'.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hAe | hAe
    · left
      rw [hAe, pairDensity_empty_left]
      positivity
    rcases B'.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hBe | hBe
    · left
      rw [hBe, pairDensity_empty_right]
      positivity
    right
    rw [pairDensity_not hAe hBe] at hnotd
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousPair.of_abs_pairDensity_sub_le
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousPair.of_abs_pairDensity_sub_le [DecidableRel R] {γ : ℝ}
    (h : IsHomogeneousPair R A' B' ε)
    (hclose : |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ γ) :
    IsHomogeneousPair R A B (ε + γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def] at h ⊢
  rw [abs_le] at hclose
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith [hclose.2])
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith [hclose.1])

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {A' : Finset α} {B' : Finset β} {s k : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hA'c : s ≤ A'.card) (hB'c : s ≤ B'.card)
    (hAc : A.card ≤ A'.card + k) (hBc : B.card ≤ B'.card + k) :
    |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ 2 * k * ((s : ℝ) + k) / s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have haR : (s : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hA'c
  have hbR : (s : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hB'c
  have hap : (0 : ℝ) < (A'.card : ℝ) := hsR.trans_le haR
  have hbp : (0 : ℝ) < (B'.card : ℝ) := hsR.trans_le hbR
  have hmass : (0 : ℝ) < (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ) := mul_pos hap hbp
  have hdA : ((A \ A').card : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (A \ A').card ≤ k := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hA]
      omega
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have hdB : ((B \ B').card : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (B \ B').card ≤ k := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hB]
      omega
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have hAcR : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) + k := by exact_mod_cast hAc
  have hBcR : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ) + k := by exact_mod_cast hBc
  
  have hstripA : ((A \ A').card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * ((B'.card : ℝ) + k) :=
    mul_le_mul hdA hBcR (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hkR
  have hstripB : (A.card : ℝ) * ((B \ B').card : ℝ) ≤ ((A'.card : ℝ) + k) * k :=
    mul_le_mul hAcR hdB (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  
  have hstep : |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B|
      ≤ ((k : ℝ) * ((B'.card : ℝ) + k) + ((A'.card : ℝ) + k) * k)
        / ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hmass]
    calc |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
        ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B \ B').card : ℝ) :=
          abs_pairDensity_sub_mul_le hA hB
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * ((B'.card : ℝ) + k) + ((A'.card : ℝ) + k) * k := by linarith
  
  have hdiv : ((k : ℝ) * ((B'.card : ℝ) + k) + ((A'.card : ℝ) + k) * k)
      / ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * k * ((s : ℝ) + k) / (s : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hmass (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hkR hsR.le) hap.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr hbR),
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hkR hsR.le) hbp.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr haR),
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hkR hkR) (sub_nonneg.mpr haR)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hbR),
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hkR hkR) hsR.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr haR),
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hkR hkR) hsR.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr hbR)]
  calc |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'|
      = |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| := abs_sub_comm _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * k * ((s : ℝ) + k) / (s : ℝ) ^ 2 := hstep.trans hdiv

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow_one
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow_one [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hA'c : s ≤ A'.card) (hB'c : s ≤ B'.card)
    (hAc : A.card ≤ A'.card + 1) (hBc : B.card ≤ B'.card + 1) :
    |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ 2 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) / s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa using abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow (k := 1) hs hA hB hA'c hB'c hAc hBc

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_of_half_le
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_of_half_le (R : α → β → Prop) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β)
    (hε : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ε) : IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def]
  rcases le_or_gt (pairDensity R A B) (1 / 2) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (h.trans hε)
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_singleton
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_singleton [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (R : α → β → Prop)
    (a : α) (b : β) : IsHomogeneousPair R {a} {b} 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isHomogeneousPair_def, pairDensity_singleton_left]
  by_cases h : R a b
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    rw [Finset.filter_singleton]
    simp [h]
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    rw [Finset.filter_singleton]
    simp [h]

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_relative_grow
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_relative_grow [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {A' : Finset α} {B' : Finset β} {cX cY : ℝ}
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) (hA'ne : A'.Nonempty) (hB'ne : B'.Nonempty)
    (hAc : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + cX) * A'.card)
    (hBc : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + cY) * B'.card) :
    |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ cX + cY + 2 * cX * cY
proof:
:= by
  have hap : (0 : ℝ) < (A'.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hA'ne
  have hbp : (0 : ℝ) < (B'.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hB'ne
  have hmass : (0 : ℝ) < (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ) := mul_pos hap hbp
  
  have hdA : ((A \ A').card : ℝ) ≤ cX * A'.card := by
    have h : ((A \ A').card : ℝ) = (A.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hA, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hA)]
    rw [h]; nlinarith
  have hdB : ((B \ B').card : ℝ) ≤ cY * B'.card := by
    have h : ((B \ B').card : ℝ) = (B.card : ℝ) - (B'.card : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hB, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hB)]
    rw [h]; nlinarith
  have hbound : |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
      ≤ (cX + cY + 2 * cX * cY) * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) :=
    calc |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
        ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B \ B').card : ℝ) :=
          abs_pairDensity_sub_mul_le hA hB
      _ ≤ (cX + cY + 2 * cX * cY) * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) := by nlinarith
  rw [abs_sub_comm]
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hbound hmass

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxLeft_apply (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (i : σ.Left) :
    σ.boxLeft A i = A i.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxRight_apply (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (i : σ.Right) :
    σ.boxRight A i = A i.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxGlue_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxGlue_apply_left (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1))
    (i : σ.Left) : σ.boxGlue AL AR i.1 = AL i
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxGlue, dite_eq_left i.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxGlue_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxGlue_apply_right (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1))
    (i : σ.Right) : σ.boxGlue AL AR i.1 = AR i
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxGlue, dite_eq_right i.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_boxGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxLeft_boxGlue (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1)) :
    σ.boxLeft (σ.boxGlue AL AR) = AL
proof: := funext fun i => boxGlue_apply_left σ AL AR i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxRight_boxGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxRight_boxGlue (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1)) :
    σ.boxRight (σ.boxGlue AL AR) = AR
proof: := funext fun i => boxGlue_apply_right σ AL AR i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxGlue_boxLeft_boxRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxGlue_boxLeft_boxRight (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    σ.boxGlue (σ.boxLeft A) (σ.boxRight A) = A
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [boxGlue]
  split <;> rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_tuples_iff_split
statement:
theorem mem_tuples_iff_split (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    x ∈ A.tuples ↔
      σ.restrictLeft x ∈ (σ.boxLeft A).tuples ∧ σ.restrictRight x ∈ (σ.boxRight A).tuples
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteBox.mem_tuples, boxLeft_apply, boxRight_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun i => h i.1, fun i => h i.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR⟩ i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ σ.left
    · exact hL ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact hR ⟨i, hi⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_tuples_iff_splitEquiv
statement:
theorem mem_tuples_iff_splitEquiv (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    x ∈ A.tuples ↔
      (σ.splitEquiv V x).1 ∈ (σ.boxLeft A).tuples ∧
        (σ.splitEquiv V x).2 ∈ (σ.boxRight A).tuples
proof:
:=
  mem_tuples_iff_split σ A x

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_split
statement:
theorem boxMass_split (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass w A
      = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxLeft A)
        * boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxRight A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass, boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass, boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_prod_compl (M := ℝ) σ.left fun i => finsetMass (w i) (A i)]
  congr 1
  · exact (Finset.prod_coe_sort σ.left fun i => finsetMass (w i) (A i)).symm
  · exact Finset.prod_subtype (M := ℝ) (p := fun i => i ∉ σ.left) σ.leftᶜ
      (fun _ => Finset.mem_compl) fun i => finsetMass (w i) (A i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_glue
statement:
theorem boxMass_glue (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1)) :
    boxMass w (σ.boxGlue AL AR)
      = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) AL
        * boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) AR
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_split σ w, boxLeft_boxGlue, boxRight_boxGlue]

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_swap
statement:
