        < ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∃ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hprodnn : ∀ g : ι → β, 0 ≤ ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    fun g => Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hwt _
  have htotal : ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      = ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    Finset.prod_univ_sum t fun _ x => wt x
  have hswap := sum_filter_pair_mem_eq_badCount t wt i₁ i₂ Bad
  have hcover : ∀ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter
        (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card : ℝ) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hcon g hg
    have hmem : e ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e) :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ e, he⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨e, hmem⟩
    exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hge : ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∏ j, wt (g j)
      ≤ ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
          ((Finset.univ.filter
            (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card : ℝ)
            * ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun g hg =>
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (hprodnn g) (hcover g hg)
  have hmarg : ∑ e : E, ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
        (fun g => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j)
      = ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ =>
      sum_piFinset_filter_pair_mem t wt (hne e) (Bad e)
  rw [htotal] at hlt
  rw [← hmarg, hswap] at hlt
  linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e)
    (Dev : E → Finset (β × β)) (w : E → ℝ) :
    ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e else 0)
      = ∑ e : E, w e * ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e else 0)
      = ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∑ e : E,
          if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e * ∏ j, wt (g j) else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
        rw [mul_ite, mul_zero, mul_comm (∏ j, wt (g j)) (w e)]
    _ = ∑ e : E, ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
          if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e * ∏ j, wt (g j) else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ e : E, w e * ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
          (fun g => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e), ∏ j, wt (g j) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ e : E, w e * ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by
          rw [sum_piFinset_filter_pair_mem t wt (hne e) (Dev e)]

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e)
    (Dev : E → Finset (β × β)) (w μe : E → ℝ)
    (hμe : ∀ e : E, w e * ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
        ≤ μe e * ((∑ x ∈ t (i₁ e), wt x) * ∑ x ∈ t (i₂ e), wt x)) :
    ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e else 0)
      ≤ (∑ e : E, μe e) * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost t wt i₁ i₂ hne Dev w, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => ?_
  have hR : 0 ≤ ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => hwt x
  have hprod : ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      = (∑ x ∈ t (i₁ e), wt x) * ((∑ x ∈ t (i₂ e), wt x)
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ (i₁ e)),
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)) _
        (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(hne e).symm, Finset.mem_univ (i₂ e)⟩)]
  have hfac : ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      = (∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2)
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
    (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
  rw [hfac, hprod]
  calc w e * ((∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2)
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
      = (w e * ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2)
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
        (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (μe e * ((∑ x ∈ t (i₁ e), wt x) * ∑ x ∈ t (i₂ e), wt x))
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hμe e) hR
    _ = μe e * ((∑ x ∈ t (i₁ e), wt x) * ((∑ x ∈ t (i₂ e), wt x)
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)) := by
        ring

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad_cost_le
statement:
theorem exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad_cost_le {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Bad : E → Finset (β × β))
    (cost : (ι → β) → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g) {σ μ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hWpos : 0 < ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hbad : ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
        ≤ σ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hexp : ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g
        ≤ μ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∃ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
      (∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e) ∧ cost g ≤ μ / (1 - σ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hσ' : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - σ := by linarith
  have hprodnn : ∀ g : ι → β, 0 ≤ ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    fun g => Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hwt _
  
  have hcompl : ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
        (fun g => ¬ ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j)
      ≤ σ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x := by
    calc ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
          (fun g => ¬ ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j)
        ≤ ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
            (fun g => ¬ ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e),
            ((Finset.univ.filter
              (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card : ℝ)
              * ∏ j, wt (g j) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun g hg => ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hg
          push Not at hg
          obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hg.2
          have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter
              (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr
              ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ e, he⟩⟩
          exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (hprodnn g) hone
      _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
            ((Finset.univ.filter
              (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card : ℝ)
              * ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
            fun g _ _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hprodnn g)
      _ = ∑ e : E, ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
            (fun g => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
          (sum_filter_pair_mem_eq_badCount t wt i₁ i₂ Bad).symm
      _ = ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
            * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ =>
            sum_piFinset_filter_pair_mem t wt (hne e) (Bad e)
      _ ≤ σ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x := hbad
  
  have htotal : ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      = ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    Finset.prod_univ_sum t fun _ x => wt x
  have hsplit : ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∏ j, wt (g j)
      = (∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
          (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j))
        + ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
            (fun g => ¬ ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not _ _ _).symm
  have hgoodmass : (1 - σ) * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      ≤ ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
          (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j) := by
    nlinarith [hcompl, htotal, hsplit]
  have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ := by
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun g _ => mul_nonneg (hprodnn g) (hcost g)
    nlinarith [hWpos, hexp]
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  
  have hgoodpos : 0 < ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
      (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hσ' hWpos) hgoodmass
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀, hFg₀⟩ : ∃ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
      (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), 0 < ∏ j, wt (g j) := by
    by_contra hz
    push Not at hz
    exact absurd hgoodpos (not_lt.mpr (Finset.sum_nonpos fun g hg => hz g hg))
  
  
  have hstrict : μ / (1 - σ) * ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
        (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j)
      < ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
          (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e),
          (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun g hg => ?_) ⟨g₀, hg₀, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨hgpi, hgood⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hg
      have hcg : μ / (1 - σ) < cost g := hcon g hgpi hgood
      rw [mul_comm (μ / (1 - σ)) (∏ j, wt (g j))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcg.le (hprodnn g)
    · obtain ⟨hgpi, hgood⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hg₀
      have hcg : μ / (1 - σ) < cost g₀ := hcon g₀ hgpi hgood
      calc μ / (1 - σ) * ∏ j, wt (g₀ j)
          < cost g₀ * ∏ j, wt (g₀ j) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcg hFg₀
        _ = (∏ j, wt (g₀ j)) * cost g₀ := mul_comm _ _
  have hsub : ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
        (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g
      ≤ ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      fun g _ _ => mul_nonneg (hprodnn g) (hcost g)
  have hc₀nn : 0 ≤ μ / (1 - σ) := div_nonneg hμ0 hσ'.le
  have hlast : μ / (1 - σ) * ((1 - σ) * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
      ≤ μ / (1 - σ) * ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
          (fun g => ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgoodmass hc₀nn
  have hid : μ / (1 - σ) * ((1 - σ) * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
      = μ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hσ')]
  linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_piFinset_cost_le
statement:
theorem exists_piFinset_cost_le (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (cost : (ι → β) → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g) {μ : ℝ}
    (hWpos : 0 < ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hexp : ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g
        ≤ μ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∃ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, cost g ≤ μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, hg, -, hcostg⟩ := exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad_cost_le (E := Empty) t wt hwt
    Empty.elim Empty.elim (fun e => e.elim) Empty.elim cost hcost (σ := 0) (μ := μ)
    (by norm_num) hWpos (by simp) hexp
  exact ⟨g, hg, by simpa using hcostg⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.padWordToLength_length
statement:
theorem padWordToLength_length {t : ℕ} {w : List Bool} (h : w.length ≤ t) :
    (padWordToLength t w).length = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [padWordToLength, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.prefix_padWordToLength
statement: theorem prefix_padWordToLength (t : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : w <+: padWordToLength t w
proof:
:=
  List.prefix_append _ _

name: RegularityLemmata.padWordToLength_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem padWordToLength_nil (t : ℕ) : padWordToLength t [] = List.replicate t false
proof:
:= by
  simp [padWordToLength]

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.toInternal_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toInternal_apply (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    e.toInternal x = e.internal x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.ext
statement:
theorem ext {e₁ e₂ : ProperEmbedding s t} (hi : ∀ x, e₁.internal x = e₂.internal x)
    (hl : ∀ l, e₁.leaf l = e₂.leaf l) : e₁ = e₂
proof:
:= by
  cases e₁; cases e₂; congr 1
  · exact funext hi
  · exact funext hl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.length_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_leaf (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) :
    (e.leaf l).1.length = t
proof: := (e.leaf l).2

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.length_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_internal (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    (e.internal x).1.length < t
proof: := (e.internal x).2

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.id_internal
statement: @[simp] theorem id_internal (x : InternalNode s) : (id s).internal x = x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.id_leaf
statement: @[simp] theorem id_leaf (l : LeafNode s) : (id s).leaf l = l
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.toInternal_id
statement: @[simp] theorem toInternal_id (s : ℕ) : (id s).toInternal = InternalEmbedding.id s
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.comp_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_internal {u : ℕ} (g : ProperEmbedding t u) (f : ProperEmbedding s t)
    (x : InternalNode s) : (comp g f).internal x = g.internal (f.internal x)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.comp_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_leaf {u : ℕ} (g : ProperEmbedding t u) (f : ProperEmbedding s t)
    (l : LeafNode s) : (comp g f).leaf l = g.leaf (f.leaf l)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (f : ProperEmbedding s t) : comp f (id s) = f
proof:
:= ext (fun _ => rfl)
  (fun _ => rfl)

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.id_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem id_comp (f : ProperEmbedding s t) : comp (id t) f = f
proof:
:= ext (fun _ => rfl)
  (fun _ => rfl)

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.toInternal_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem toInternal_comp {u : ℕ} (g : ProperEmbedding t u) (f : ProperEmbedding s t) :
    (comp g f).toInternal = InternalEmbedding.comp g.toInternal f.toInternal
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.internal_injective
statement: theorem internal_injective (e : ProperEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e.internal
proof:
:=
  e.toInternal.injective

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.branch_leaf_preserved
statement:
theorem branch_leaf_preserved (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode s)
    (l : LeafNode s) (h : BranchBelow b x.1 l.1) :
    BranchBelow b (e.internal x).1 (e.leaf l).1
proof: := e.branch_leaf b x l h

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.leaf_injective
statement: theorem leaf_injective (e : ProperEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e.leaf
proof:
:= by
  intro l₁ l₂ hl
  by_contra hne
  have hne' : l₁.1 ≠ l₂.1 := fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
  have hlen : l₁.1.length = l₂.1.length := by rw [l₁.2, l₂.2]
  rcases prefix_trichotomy l₁.1 l₂.1 with hp | hp | ⟨z, b, h1, h2⟩
  · exact hne' (eq_of_prefix_of_prefix_of_length_eq hp List.prefix_rfl hlen)
  · exact hne' (eq_of_prefix_of_prefix_of_length_eq List.prefix_rfl hp hlen)
  · have hz : z.length < s := by
      have hlt := h1.length_lt
      have := l₁.2
      omega
    refine not_branchBelow_of_branchBelow (b := b) (e.branch_leaf b ⟨z, hz⟩ l₁ h1) ?_
    rw [hl]
    exact e.branch_leaf (!b) ⟨z, hz⟩ l₂ h2

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.internal_ne_leaf
statement:
theorem internal_ne_leaf (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) (l : LeafNode s) :
    (e.internal x).1 ≠ (e.leaf l).1
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  have h1 := (e.internal x).2
  have h2 := (e.leaf l).2
  rw [hcon, h2] at h1
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_val (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : TreeNode s) :
    (e.vertex x).1
      = if h : x.1.length < s then (e.internal ⟨x.1, h⟩).1
        else (e.leaf ⟨x.1, le_antisymm x.2 (not_lt.mp h)⟩).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertex]
  split <;> rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_of_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_of_internal (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    e.vertex (internalToTree x) = internalToTree (e.internal x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [vertex_val, dite_eq_left (show (internalToTree x).1.length < s from x.2)]
  rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_of_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_of_leaf (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) :
    e.vertex (leafToTree l) = leafToTree (e.leaf l)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  have hnl : ¬ (leafToTree l).1.length < s := by rw [leafToTree_val, l.2]; omega
  rw [vertex_val, dite_eq_right hnl]
  rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_injective
statement: theorem vertex_injective (e : ProperEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e.vertex
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hval : (e.vertex x).1 = (e.vertex y).1 := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  rw [vertex_val, vertex_val] at hval
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  by_cases hx : x.1.length < s <;> by_cases hy : y.1.length < s
  · rw [dite_eq_left hx, dite_eq_left hy] at hval
    simpa using congrArg Subtype.val (e.internal_injective (Subtype.ext hval))
  · rw [dite_eq_left hx, dite_eq_right hy] at hval
    exact absurd hval (e.internal_ne_leaf _ _)
  · rw [dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_left hy] at hval
    exact absurd hval.symm (e.internal_ne_leaf _ _)
  · rw [dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right hy] at hval
    simpa using congrArg Subtype.val (e.leaf_injective (Subtype.ext hval))

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafParent_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leafParent_val (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    (leafParent l hl).1 = l.1.dropLast
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafParent_append_getLast
statement:
theorem leafParent_append_getLast (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    (leafParent l hl).1 ++ [l.1.getLast hl] = l.1
proof: := List.dropLast_append_getLast hl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafPrefix_of_ne_nil
statement:
theorem leafPrefix_of_ne_nil (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    leafPrefix e l = (e (leafParent l hl)).1 ++ [l.1.getLast hl]
proof: := dite_eq_right hl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafPrefix_of_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem leafPrefix_of_nil (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 = []) :
    leafPrefix e l = []
proof: := dite_eq_left hl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafPrefix_length_le
statement:
theorem leafPrefix_length_le (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) :
    (leafPrefix e l).length ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : l.1 = []
  · rw [leafPrefix_of_nil e l hl]
    simp
  · rw [leafPrefix_of_ne_nil e l hl]
    have := (e (leafParent l hl)).2
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_toInternal
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendProper_toInternal (e : InternalEmbedding s t) :
    (extendProper e).toInternal = e
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendProper_internal (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    (extendProper e).internal x = e x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_leaf_val
statement:
theorem extendProper_leaf_val (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    ((extendProper e).leaf l).1
      = padWordToLength t ((e (leafParent l hl)).1 ++ [l.1.getLast hl])
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((extendProper e).leaf l).1 = padWordToLength t (leafPrefix e l) from rfl,
    leafPrefix_of_ne_nil e l hl]

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_leaf_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendProper_leaf_zero (e : InternalEmbedding 0 t) (l : LeafNode 0) :
    ((extendProper e).leaf l).1 = List.replicate t false
proof:
:= by
  have hl : l.1 = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero l.2
  rw [show ((extendProper e).leaf l).1 = padWordToLength t (leafPrefix e l) from rfl,
    leafPrefix_of_nil e l hl, padWordToLength_nil]

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_properEmbedding_of_child_branches
statement:
theorem exists_properEmbedding_of_child_branches {s t : ℕ}
    (f : (x : List Bool) → x.length ≤ s → List Bool)
    (hint : ∀ x (hx : x.length < s), (f x (by omega)).length < t)
    (hstep : ∀ x (hx : x.length < s) b,
      ∃ w, f (x ++ [b]) (by simp; omega) = f x (by omega) ++ [b] ++ w) :
    ∃ e : ProperEmbedding s t, ∀ x : InternalNode s,
      (e.internal x).1 = f x.1 (by have := x.2; omega)
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix : ∀ w x (h : (x ++ w).length ≤ s),
      f x (by simp only [List.length_append] at h; omega) <+: f (x ++ w) h := by
    intro w
    induction w with
    | nil => intro x h; simp
    | cons b w ih =>
      intro x h
      have hx : x.length < s := by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at h; omega
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hstep x hx b
      have h₁ : f x (by omega) <+: f (x ++ [b]) (by simp; omega) := by
        rw [hv]
        exact List.prefix_append _ _ |>.trans (List.prefix_append _ _)
      have h₂ := ih (x ++ [b]) (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using h)
      simpa [List.append_assoc] using h₁.trans h₂
  let e : InternalEmbedding s t := {
    toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 (by have := x.2; omega), hint x.1 x.2⟩
    branch := by
      intro b x y hxy
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hxy
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hstep x.1 x.2 b
      have hp := hprefix w (x.1 ++ [b]) (by rw [hw]; exact Nat.le_of_lt y.2)
      have hb : f x.1 (by have := x.2; omega) ++ [b] <+:
          f (x.1 ++ [b]) (by simp; have := x.2; omega) := by
        rw [hv]
        exact List.prefix_append _ _
      change f x.1 _ ++ [b] <+: f y.1 _
      simpa [hw] using hb.trans hp }
  exact ⟨e.extendProper, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.IsDeltaConstantOn.mono
statement:
theorem IsDeltaConstantOn.mono (h : IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ W) (hδ : δ ≤ δ') :
    IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ' W
proof:
:=
  fun v hv v' hv' ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le (h v hv v' hv') hδ

name: RegularityLemmata.IsDeltaConstantOn.subset
statement:
theorem IsDeltaConstantOn.subset {W' : Finset α} (h : IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ W)
    (hW' : W' ⊆ W) : IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ W'
proof:
:=
  fun v hv v' hv' ↦ h v (hW' hv) v' (hW' hv')

name: RegularityLemmata.isDeltaConstantOn_empty
statement:
theorem isDeltaConstantOn_empty (φ : α → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) :
    IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ (∅ : Finset α)
proof:
:=
  fun v hv ↦ absurd hv (by simp)

name: RegularityLemmata.isDeltaConstantOn_singleton
statement:
theorem isDeltaConstantOn_singleton (hδ : 0 < δ) (v : α) :
    IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ ({v} : Finset α)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw w' hw'
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hw hw'
  subst hw; subst hw'
  simpa using hδ

name: RegularityLemmata.isDeltaConstantOn_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem isDeltaConstantOn_singleton_iff (v : α) :
    IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ ({v} : Finset α) ↔ 0 < δ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun hδ ↦ isDeltaConstantOn_singleton hδ v⟩
  have := h v (Finset.mem_singleton_self v) v (Finset.mem_singleton_self v)
  simpa using this

name: RegularityLemmata.IsAlmostConstantOn.mono_delta
statement:
theorem IsAlmostConstantOn.mono_delta (h : IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ ε V) (hδ : δ ≤ δ') :
    IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ' ε V
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨W, hWV, hcard, hconst⟩
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr ⟨W, hWV, hcard, hconst.mono hδ⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.IsAlmostConstantOn.mono_eps
statement:
theorem IsAlmostConstantOn.mono_eps (h : IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ ε V) (hε : ε ≤ ε') :
    IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ ε' V
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨W, hWV, hcard, hconst⟩
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · refine Or.inr ⟨W, hWV, lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hcard, hconst⟩
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RegularityLemmata.isAlmostConstantOn_empty
statement:
theorem isAlmostConstantOn_empty (φ : α → ℝ) (δ ε : ℝ) :
    IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ ε (∅ : Finset α)
proof:
:=
  Or.inl rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.IsDeltaConstantOn.isAlmostConstantOn
statement:
theorem IsDeltaConstantOn.isAlmostConstantOn (h : IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ V) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ ε V
proof:
:= by
  rcases V.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hV
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · refine Or.inr ⟨V, subset_refl V, ?_, h⟩
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (V.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hV
    nlinarith

name: RegularityLemmata.isAlmostConstantOn_of_one_le
statement:
theorem isAlmostConstantOn_of_one_le (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 1 ≤ ε) :
    IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ ε V
proof:
:= by
  rcases V.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨v, hv⟩
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · refine Or.inr ⟨{v}, Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hv, ?_,
      isDeltaConstantOn_singleton hδ v⟩
    have h1 : (1 - ε) * (V.card : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    simpa using lt_of_le_of_lt h1 one_pos

name: RegularityLemmata.IsAlmostConstantPair.mono_delta
proof:
:=
  IsAlmostConstantOn.mono_delta h hδ

name: RegularityLemmata.IsAlmostConstantPair.mono_eps
proof:
:=
  IsAlmostConstantOn.mono_eps h hε

name: RegularityLemmata.IsAlmostConstantOn.isAlmostConstantPair_singleton_left
statement:
theorem IsAlmostConstantOn.isAlmostConstantPair_singleton_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {f : RectKernel X Y} {a : X} {B : Finset Y} (h : IsAlmostConstantOn (f a) δ ε B) :
    IsAlmostConstantPair f δ ε {a} B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases h with hB | ⟨W, hWB, hcard, hconst⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [hB, Finset.product_empty])
  · refine Or.inr ⟨{a} ×ˢ W, Finset.product_subset_product Finset.Subset.rfl hWB, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_singleton]
      simpa using hcard
    · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy ⟨x', y'⟩ hxy'
      rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton] at hxy hxy'
      obtain ⟨rfl, hy⟩ := hxy
      obtain ⟨rfl, hy'⟩ := hxy'
      exact hconst _ hy _ hy'

name: RegularityLemmata.IsAlmostConstantOn.isAlmostConstantPair_singleton_right
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases h with hA | ⟨W, hWA, hcard, hconst⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [hA, Finset.empty_product])
  · refine Or.inr ⟨W ×ˢ {b}, Finset.product_subset_product hWA Finset.Subset.rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_singleton]
      simpa using hcard
    · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy ⟨x', y'⟩ hxy'
      rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton] at hxy hxy'
      obtain ⟨hx, rfl⟩ := hxy
      obtain ⟨hx', rfl⟩ := hxy'
      exact hconst _ hx _ hx'

name: RegularityLemmata.isAlmostConstantPair_singleton
statement:
theorem isAlmostConstantPair_singleton [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (a : X) (b : Y) : IsAlmostConstantPair f δ ε {a} {b}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Or.inr ⟨{a} ×ˢ {b}, Finset.Subset.rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_singleton]
    norm_num
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy ⟨x', y'⟩ hxy'
    rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_singleton] at hxy hxy'
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy'
    simpa using hδ

name: RegularityLemmata.IsDeltaConstantOn.exists_max_min_center
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vmax, hmax, hmaxle⟩ := V.exists_max_image φ hV
  obtain ⟨vmin, hmin, hminle⟩ := V.exists_min_image φ hV
  refine ⟨vmax, hmax, vmin, hmin, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := h vmax hmax vmin hmin
  have h2 := hmaxle v hv
  have h3 := hminle v hv
  rw [abs_lt] at h1 ⊢
  constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.isDeltaConstantOn_iff_exists_center
statement:
theorem isDeltaConstantOn_iff_exists_center :
    IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ V ↔ ∃ r : ℝ, ∀ v ∈ V, |φ v - r| < δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases V.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hV
    · exact ⟨0, fun v hv ↦ absurd hv (Finset.notMem_empty v)⟩
    · obtain ⟨vmax, -, vmin, -, hc⟩ := h.exists_max_min_center hV
      exact ⟨_, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩ v hv v' hv'
    have h1 := hr v hv
    have h2 := hr v' hv'
    rw [abs_lt] at h1 h2 ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.IsDeltaConstantOn.exists_center_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem IsDeltaConstantOn.exists_center_mem_Icc (h : IsDeltaConstantOn φ δ V)
    (hφ : ∀ v ∈ V, φ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ v ∈ V, |φ v - r| < δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases V.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hV
  · exact ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, fun v hv ↦ absurd hv (Finset.notMem_empty v)⟩
  · obtain ⟨vmax, hmax, vmin, hmin, hc⟩ := h.exists_max_min_center hV
    have hM := hφ vmax hmax
    have hm := hφ vmin hmin
    exact ⟨_, ⟨by linarith [hM.1, hm.1], by linarith [hM.2, hm.2]⟩, hc⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.isAlmostConstantPair_op_of_isAlmostConstantPair
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases h with hAB | ⟨W, hWAB, hcard, hconst⟩
  · left
    rw [Finset.product_eq_empty] at hAB ⊢
    exact hAB.symm
  · right
    refine ⟨W.image Prod.swap, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      have hq' := Finset.mem_product.mp (hWAB hq)
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hq'.2, hq'.1⟩
    · rw [Finset.card_product] at hcard
      rwa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Prod.swap_injective, Finset.card_product,
        Nat.mul_comm]
    · intro p hp p' hp'
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨q', hq', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp'
      exact hconst q hq q' hq'

name: RegularityLemmata.isAlmostConstantPair_op_iff
statement:
theorem isAlmostConstantPair_op_iff {f : RectKernel X Y} {A : Finset X} {B : Finset Y} :
    IsAlmostConstantPair (RectKernel.op f) δ ε B A ↔ IsAlmostConstantPair f δ ε A B
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ isAlmostConstantPair_op_of_isAlmostConstantPair h,
   fun h ↦ isAlmostConstantPair_op_of_isAlmostConstantPair h⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_separation_of_not_isAlmostConstantOn
statement:
theorem exists_separation_of_not_isAlmostConstantOn [DecidableEq α]
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (h : ¬ IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ (2 * ε) V) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (ε * V.card ≤ ((V.filter fun x ↦ φ x ≤ r).card : ℝ)) ∧
      (ε * V.card ≤ ((V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).card : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hVne : V.Nonempty := by
    rcases V.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | h'
    · exact absurd (isAlmostConstantOn_empty φ δ (2 * ε)) h
    · exact h'
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (V.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hVne
  have hhalf : 2 * ε < 1 := by
    by_contra hge
    exact h (isAlmostConstantOn_of_one_le hδ (le_of_not_gt hge))
  set N := V.card with hNdef
  set m := ⌈ε * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ with hmdef
  have hmR : (m : ℝ) < ε * N + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
  have hεm : ε * (N : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.le_ceil _
  
  set Qual := V.filter (fun x ↦ m ≤ (V.filter fun y ↦ φ y ≤ φ x).card) with hQdef
  have hQne : Qual.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzmax⟩ := V.exists_max_image φ hVne
    refine ⟨z, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hz, ?_⟩⟩
    have hall : V.filter (fun y ↦ φ y ≤ φ z) = V :=
      Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun y hy ↦ hzmax y hy
    rw [hall]
    have : ε * (N : ℝ) < N := by nlinarith
    have hmN : m ≤ N := by
      rw [hmdef]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.ceil_le.mpr this.le
    exact hmN
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀Q, hx₀min⟩ := Qual.exists_min_image φ hQne
  set r := φ x₀ with hrdef
  have hx₀ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx₀Q
  refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine le_trans hεm ?_
    exact_mod_cast hx₀.2
  · 
    have hlt : (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card + 1 ≤ m := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      
      have hge : m ≤ (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card := by omega
      have hne : (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.card_pos]
        have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr (by positivity)
        omega
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzmax⟩ := (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).exists_max_image φ hne
      have hzV := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1
      have hzr : φ z < r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2
      have hsub : (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r) ⊆ V.filter (fun y ↦ φ y ≤ φ z) := by
        intro w hw
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).1, hzmax w hw⟩
      have hzQ : z ∈ Qual := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨hzV, le_trans hge (Finset.card_le_card hsub)⟩
      exact absurd (hx₀min z hzQ) (not_le.mpr hzr)
    
    have hU : ((V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 - 2 * ε) * N := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      refine h (Or.inr ⟨V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ,
        Finset.filter_subset _ _, hcon, ?_⟩)
      intro v hv v' hv'
      have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv').2
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
    
    have hcover : (N : ℝ) ≤ ((V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card : ℝ)
        + ((V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ).card : ℝ)
        + ((V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) := by
      have hsub : V ⊆ (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r)
          ∪ ((V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ)
            ∪ (V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x)) := by
        intro x hx
        rcases lt_or_ge (φ x) r with h1 | h1
        · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, h1⟩)
        · rcases lt_or_ge (φ x) (r + δ) with h2 | h2
          · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
              (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩))
          · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
              (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, h2⟩))
      have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      have hu2 := Finset.card_union_le
        ((V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ)) (V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x)
      have hu1 := Finset.card_union_le (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r)
        ((V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ) ∪ (V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x))
      have hthis : N ≤ (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card
          + ((V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ).card
            + (V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).card) := by
        calc N = V.card := rfl
          _ ≤ _ := hcard
          _ ≤ _ := hu1
          _ ≤ _ := Nat.add_le_add_left hu2 _
      have hthis' : N ≤ (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card
          + (V.filter fun x ↦ r ≤ φ x ∧ φ x < r + δ).card
          + (V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).card := by omega
      exact_mod_cast hthis'
    have hltR : ((V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) - 1 := by
      have : ((V.filter fun x ↦ φ x < r).card : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hlt
      linarith
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_separation_mem_Icc_of_not_isAlmostConstantOn
statement:
theorem exists_separation_mem_Icc_of_not_isAlmostConstantOn [DecidableEq α]
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hrange : ∀ x ∈ V, φ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (h : ¬ IsAlmostConstantOn φ δ (2 * ε) V) :
    ∃ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      (ε * V.card ≤ ((V.filter fun x ↦ φ x ≤ r).card : ℝ)) ∧
      (ε * V.card ≤ ((V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).card : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := exists_separation_of_not_isAlmostConstantOn hδ hε h
  have hVne : V.Nonempty := by
    rcases V.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | h'
    · exact absurd (isAlmostConstantOn_empty φ δ (2 * ε)) h
    · exact h'
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (V.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hVne
  have hlow : (V.filter fun x ↦ φ x ≤ r).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos]
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    have h0 : ((V.filter fun x ↦ φ x ≤ r).card : ℝ) = 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_zero.mp hc
    nlinarith
  have hhigh : (V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos]
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    have h0 : ((V.filter fun x ↦ r + δ ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) = 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_zero.mp hc
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hlow
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hhigh
  have haV := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1
  have har := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hbV := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1
  have hbr := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
  refine ⟨r, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, h1, h2⟩
  · exact le_trans (hrange a haV).1 har
  · have := (hrange b hbV).2
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_levelSets
statement:
theorem abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_levelSets [DecidableEq α] {φ : α → ℝ}
    {A Q : Finset α} {β ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hQ : Q ⊆ A) (hQne : Q.Nonempty)
    (hrange : ∀ x ∈ A, φ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hlevels : ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ 1 →
      |(((A.filter fun x ↦ (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x) ∩ Q).card : ℝ) / Q.card
        - ((A.filter fun x ↦ (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / A.card| ≤ β) :
    |averageOn Q φ - averageOn A φ| ≤ 2 * ν + (1 + ν) * β
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := hQne.mono hQ
  
  set L := (Finset.Icc 1 ⌈1 / ν⌉₊).filter (fun p : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ 1) with hLdef
  
  have hcount : ∀ x ∈ A, ((L.filter fun p : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)
      = (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hrange x hx
    have hfloor_le : ⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ ≤ ⌈1 / ν⌉₊ :=
      le_trans (Nat.floor_le_floor (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hν.le))
        (Nat.floor_le_ceil _)
    have heq : L.filter (fun p : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x) = Finset.Icc 1 ⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ := by
      ext p
      simp only [hLdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hp1, hpK⟩, hp1'⟩, hpφ⟩
        exact ⟨hp1, Nat.le_floor ((le_div_iff₀ hν).mpr (by linarith [hpφ]))⟩
      · rintro ⟨hp1, hpfl⟩
        have hpφ : (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x := by
          have := (Nat.le_floor_iff (by positivity)).mp hpfl
          calc (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ (φ x / ν) * ν := by
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast this) hν.le
            _ = φ x := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hν)
        exact ⟨⟨⟨hp1, le_trans (Nat.le_floor ((le_div_iff₀ hν).mpr (by linarith)))
          hfloor_le⟩, le_trans hpφ h1⟩, hpφ⟩
    rw [heq, Nat.card_Icc]
    simp
  
  have hsandwich : ∀ S : Finset α, S ⊆ A → S.Nonempty →
      |averageOn S φ - ν * ((∑ p ∈ L, ((S.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ))
        / S.card)| ≤ ν := by
    intro S hSA hSne
    have hSpos : (0 : ℝ) < (S.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hSne
    
    have hswap : ∑ p ∈ L, ((S.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)
        = ∑ x ∈ S, (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : ∀ p ∈ L, ((S.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)
          = ∑ x ∈ S, (if (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
        intro p _
        rw [Finset.sum_boole]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      exact hcount x (hSA hx)
    
    have hlow : ∀ x ∈ S, ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ φ x := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨h0, _⟩ := hrange x (hSA hx)
      calc ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ ν * (φ x / ν) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Nat.floor_le (by positivity)) hν.le
        _ = φ x := mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hν)
    have hhigh : ∀ x ∈ S, φ x < ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) + ν := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨h0, _⟩ := hrange x (hSA hx)
      have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (φ x / ν)
      calc φ x = ν * (φ x / ν) := (mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hν)).symm
        _ < ν * ((⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) := by
            exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this hν
        _ = ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) + ν := by ring
    
    rw [hswap, abs_le]
    have hsum_low : ∑ x ∈ S, ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, φ x :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hlow
    have hsum_high : ∑ x ∈ S, φ x ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, (ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) + ν) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx ↦ (hhigh x hx).le
    have hmul : ν * ((∑ x ∈ S, (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ)) / S.card)
        = (∑ x ∈ S, ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ)) / S.card := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
    have havg : averageOn S φ = (∑ x ∈ S, φ x) / S.card := rfl
    have hplus : ∑ x ∈ S, (ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ) + ν)
        = (∑ x ∈ S, ν * (⌊φ x / ν⌋₊ : ℝ)) + ν * S.card := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    constructor
    · rw [havg, hmul]
      rw [div_sub_div_same, le_div_iff₀ hSpos] at *
      nlinarith [hsum_high, hplus]
    · rw [havg, hmul]
      rw [div_sub_div_same, div_le_iff₀ hSpos]
      nlinarith [hsum_low]
  
  have hQside := hsandwich Q hQ hQne
  have hAside := hsandwich A (subset_refl A) hAne
  have hApos : (0 : ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hAne
  have hQpos : (0 : ℝ) < (Q.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hQne
  
  have hLcard : ν * (L.card : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ν := by
    have h1 : L.card ≤ ⌈1 / ν⌉₊ := by
      calc L.card ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌈1 / ν⌉₊).card := Finset.card_le_card
            (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        _ = ⌈1 / ν⌉₊ := by rw [Nat.card_Icc]; omega
    have h2 : (⌈1 / ν⌉₊ : ℝ) < 1 / ν + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
    have h3 : ν * (L.card : ℝ) ≤ ν * (⌈1 / ν⌉₊ : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast h1) hν.le
    have h4 : ν * (1 / ν + 1) = 1 + ν := by field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hlevel_sum : |(∑ p ∈ L, ((Q.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)) / Q.card
      - (∑ p ∈ L, ((A.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)) / A.card|
      ≤ (L.card : ℝ) * β := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
    have hbound : ∀ p ∈ L, |((Q.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / Q.card
        - ((A.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / A.card| ≤ β := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hpIcc, hp1⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      obtain ⟨hp1', -⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hpIcc
      have hQfilter : Q.filter (fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x)
          = (A.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x) ∩ Q := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_inter]
        exact ⟨fun ⟨hxQ, hxφ⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨hQ hxQ, hxφ⟩, hxQ⟩, fun ⟨⟨hxA, hxφ⟩, hxQ⟩ ↦ ⟨hxQ, hxφ⟩⟩
      rw [hQfilter]
      exact hlevels p hp1' hp1
    calc ∑ p ∈ L, |((Q.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / Q.card
          - ((A.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / A.card|
        ≤ ∑ _p ∈ L, β := Finset.sum_le_sum hbound
      _ = (L.card : ℝ) * β := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  
  set q1 := ν * ((∑ p ∈ L, ((Q.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)) / Q.card)
    with hq1def
  set a1 := ν * ((∑ p ∈ L, ((A.filter fun x ↦ (p : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ)) / A.card)
    with ha1def
  have hmid : |q1 - a1| ≤ ν * ((L.card : ℝ) * β) := by
    rw [hq1def, ha1def, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hν]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlevel_sum hν.le
  have htri : |averageOn Q φ - averageOn A φ|
      ≤ |averageOn Q φ - q1| + (|q1 - a1| + |a1 - averageOn A φ|) := by
    calc |averageOn Q φ - averageOn A φ| ≤ |averageOn Q φ - q1| + |q1 - averageOn A φ| :=
          abs_sub_le _ _ _
      _ ≤ |averageOn Q φ - q1| + (|q1 - a1| + |a1 - averageOn A φ|) := by
          have := abs_sub_le q1 a1 (averageOn A φ)
          linarith
  have hAside' : |a1 - averageOn A φ| ≤ ν := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact hAside
  have hprice : ν * ((L.card : ℝ) * β) ≤ (1 + ν) * β := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLcard hβ
    nlinarith
  linarith [hQside, hmid, htri, hAside', hprice]

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_levelSets_of_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_levelSets_of_le_one [DecidableEq α] {φ : α → ℝ}
    {A Q : Finset α} {β ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hν1 : ν ≤ 1) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hQ : Q ⊆ A)
    (hQne : Q.Nonempty) (hrange : ∀ x ∈ A, φ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hlevels : ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ 1 →
      |(((A.filter fun x ↦ (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x) ∩ Q).card : ℝ) / Q.card
        - ((A.filter fun x ↦ (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / A.card| ≤ β) :
    |averageOn Q φ - averageOn A φ| ≤ 2 * ν + 2 * β
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_levelSets hν hβ hQ hQne hrange hlevels
  nlinarith

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_one_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hQr : averageOn Q φ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    averageOn_mem_Icc fun x hx ↦ hrange x (hQ hx)
  have hAr : averageOn A φ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := averageOn_mem_Icc hrange
  rw [abs_le]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hQr
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hAr
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.coe_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_mk (f : InternalNode s → InternalNode t) (hf) :
    ⇑(mk f hf) = f
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.ext
statement: theorem ext {e₁ e₂ : InternalEmbedding s t} (h : ∀ x, e₁ x = e₂ x) : e₁ = e₂
proof:
:= by
  cases e₁; cases e₂; congr 1; exact funext h

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.branch_preserved
statement:
theorem branch_preserved (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (b : Bool) (x y : InternalNode s)
    (h : BranchBelow b x.1 y.1) : BranchBelow b (e x).1 (e y).1
proof: := e.branch b x y h

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (x : InternalNode s) : id s x = x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_apply (g : InternalEmbedding t u) (f : InternalEmbedding s t)
    (x : InternalNode s) : comp g f x = g (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (f : InternalEmbedding s t) : comp f (id s) = f
proof: := ext fun _ => rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.id_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem id_comp (f : InternalEmbedding s t) : comp (id t) f = f
proof: := ext fun _ => rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {v : ℕ} (h : InternalEmbedding u v) (g : InternalEmbedding t u)
    (f : InternalEmbedding s t) : comp (comp h g) f = comp h (comp g f)
proof: := ext fun _ => rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.isStrictPrefix_preserved
statement:
theorem isStrictPrefix_preserved (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (x y : InternalNode s)
    (h : IsStrictPrefix x.1 y.1) : IsStrictPrefix (e x).1 (e y).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_branchBelow_of_isStrictPrefix h
  exact (e.branch b x y hb).isStrictPrefix

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.apply_ne_apply_of_branchBelow
statement:
theorem apply_ne_apply_of_branchBelow (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (b : Bool)
    (z x y : InternalNode s) (hx : BranchBelow b z.1 x.1) (hy : BranchBelow (!b) z.1 y.1) :
    e x ≠ e y
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy
  refine not_branchBelow_of_branchBelow (b := b) (e.branch b z x hx) ?_
  rw [hxy]
  exact e.branch (!b) z y hy

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.injective
statement: theorem injective (e : InternalEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  by_contra hne
  have hne' : x.1 ≠ y.1 := fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
  rcases prefix_trichotomy x.1 y.1 with hp | hp | ⟨z, b, h1, h2⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_branchBelow_of_isStrictPrefix ⟨hp, hne'⟩
    have hlt := (e.branch c x y hc).length_lt
    rw [hxy] at hlt
    omega
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_branchBelow_of_isStrictPrefix ⟨hp, Ne.symm hne'⟩
    have hlt := (e.branch c y x hc).length_lt
    rw [hxy] at hlt
    omega
  · have hz : z.length < s := by
      have h1' := h1.length_lt
      have := x.2
      omega
    exact apply_ne_apply_of_branchBelow e b ⟨z, hz⟩ x y h1 h2 hxy

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.singleton_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_apply (x : InternalNode t) (y : InternalNode 1) :
    singleton x y = x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.branchLift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem branchLift_apply (h : ℕ) (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode h) :
    branchLift h b x = consInternal b x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.branchBelow_root_branchLift
statement:
theorem branchBelow_root_branchLift (h : ℕ) (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode h) :
    BranchBelow b (root h).1 (branchLift h b x).1
proof: := branchBelow_root_cons b x

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.forkFun_root
statement:
private theorem forkFun_root (x : InternalNode t) (f g : InternalEmbedding s t) :
    forkFun x f g (root s) = x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.forkFun_cons
statement:
private theorem forkFun_cons (x : InternalNode t) (f g : InternalEmbedding s t) (b : Bool)
    (y : InternalNode s) : forkFun x f g (consInternal b y) = bif b then g y else f y
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.fork_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem fork_root (x : InternalNode t) (f g : InternalEmbedding s t) (hf hg) :
    fork x f g hf hg (root s) = x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.fork_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem fork_cons (x : InternalNode t) (f g : InternalEmbedding s t) (hf hg) (b : Bool)
    (y : InternalNode s) : fork x f g hf hg (consInternal b y) = bif b then g y else f y
proof:
:=
  forkFun_cons x f g b y

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_editSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_editSet {x : ι → α} :
    x ∈ editSet R₁ R₂ A ↔ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A ∧ ¬ (R₁ x ↔ R₂ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [editSet]

name: RegularityLemmata.editSet_comm
statement: theorem editSet_comm : editSet R₁ R₂ A = editSet R₂ R₁ A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [editSet]
  exact Finset.filter_congr fun x _ => by tauto

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_comm
statement: theorem editDistance_comm : editDistance R₁ R₂ A = editDistance R₂ R₁ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [editDistance, editDistance, editSet_comm]

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_self
statement: @[simp] theorem editDistance_self : editDistance R₁ R₁ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [editDistance, editSet]

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_le_card
statement:
theorem editDistance_le_card :
    editDistance R₁ R₂ A ≤ (Fintype.piFinset A).card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_filter_le _ _

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem editDistance_triangle :
    editDistance R₁ R₃ A ≤ editDistance R₁ R₂ A + editDistance R₂ R₃ A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : editSet R₁ R₃ A ⊆ editSet R₁ R₂ A ∪ editSet R₂ R₃ A := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_editSet] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_union, mem_editSet, mem_editSet]
    by_cases h12 : R₁ x ↔ R₂ x
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx.1, fun h23 => hx.2 (h12.trans h23)⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1, h12⟩
  calc editDistance R₁ R₃ A ≤ (editSet R₁ R₂ A ∪ editSet R₂ R₃ A).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ editDistance R₁ R₂ A + editDistance R₂ R₃ A := Finset.card_union_le _ _

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_mono_box
statement:
theorem editDistance_mono_box (h : ∀ i, A i ⊆ B i) :
    editDistance R₁ R₂ A ≤ editDistance R₁ R₂ B
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_le_card fun x hx => ?_
  rw [mem_editSet] at hx ⊢
  exact ⟨Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr fun i => h i (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hx.1 i), hx.2⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_le_sum_chain
statement:
theorem editDistance_le_sum_chain {m : ℕ}
    (Rs : Fin (m + 1) → (ι → α) → Prop) [∀ i, DecidablePred (Rs i)]
    (A : ι → Finset α) :
    editDistance (Rs 0) (Rs (Fin.last m)) A
      ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, editDistance (Rs i.castSucc) (Rs i.succ) A
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    calc editDistance (Rs 0) (Rs (Fin.last (m + 1))) A
        ≤ editDistance (Rs 0) (Rs (Fin.last m).castSucc) A
            + editDistance (Rs (Fin.last m).castSucc) (Rs (Fin.last (m + 1))) A :=
          editDistance_triangle
      _ ≤ (∑ i : Fin m, editDistance (Rs i.castSucc.castSucc) (Rs i.succ.castSucc) A)
            + editDistance (Rs (Fin.last m).castSucc) (Rs (Fin.last (m + 1))) A := by
          have hih := ih (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Rs i.castSucc)
          rw [Fin.castSucc_zero] at hih
          exact Nat.add_le_add_right hih _
      _ = ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), editDistance (Rs i.castSucc) (Rs i.succ) A := by
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
          simp only [Fin.succ_castSucc, Fin.succ_last, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_univ_le_injective_add_nonInjective
statement:
theorem editDistance_univ_le_injective_add_nonInjective [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
    editDistance R₁ R₂ (fun _ => Finset.univ)
      ≤ ((editSet R₁ R₂ fun _ => Finset.univ).filter Function.Injective).card
        + (nonInjectiveMaps ι α).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [editDistance,
    ← Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := editSet R₁ R₂ fun _ => Finset.univ) Function.Injective]
  refine Nat.add_le_add_left (Finset.card_le_card fun f hf => ?_) _
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hf
  exact mem_nonInjectiveMaps.mpr hf.2

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_eq_tupleCount_of_forall_not
statement:
theorem editDistance_eq_tupleCount_of_forall_not (h : ∀ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, ¬ R₂ x) :
    editDistance R₁ R₂ A = tupleCount R₁ A
proof:
:=
  congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr fun x hx ↦ by simp [h x hx])

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_eq_tupleCount_not_of_forall
statement:
theorem editDistance_eq_tupleCount_not_of_forall (h : ∀ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, R₂ x) :
    editDistance R₁ R₂ A = tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R₁ x) A
proof:
:=
  congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr fun x hx ↦ by simp [h x hx])

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_le_of_tupleDensity_le
statement:
theorem editDistance_le_of_tupleDensity_le {ε : ℝ} (hd : tupleDensity R₁ A ≤ ε)
    (hconst : ∀ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, ¬ R₂ x) :
    (editDistance R₁ R₂ A : ℝ) ≤ ε * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [editDistance_eq_tupleCount_of_forall_not hconst]
  exact card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le hd

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_le_of_le_tupleDensity
statement:
theorem editDistance_le_of_le_tupleDensity {ε : ℝ} (hd : 1 - ε ≤ tupleDensity R₁ A)
    (hconst : ∀ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, R₂ x) (hne : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) :
    (editDistance R₁ R₂ A : ℝ) ≤ ε * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [editDistance_eq_tupleCount_not_of_forall hconst]
  refine card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le ?_
  rw [tupleDensity_neg hne]
  linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.relativeEditDistance_eq
statement:
theorem relativeEditDistance_eq :
    relativeEditDistance R₁ R₂ A
      = (editDistance R₁ R₂ A : ℝ) / ((Fintype.piFinset A).card : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.relativeEditDistance_nonneg
statement: theorem relativeEditDistance_nonneg : 0 ≤ relativeEditDistance R₁ R₂ A
proof:
:=
  densityOn_nonneg

name: RegularityLemmata.relativeEditDistance_le_one
statement: theorem relativeEditDistance_le_one : relativeEditDistance R₁ R₂ A ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  densityOn_le_one

name: RegularityLemmata.relativeEditDistance_comm
statement:
theorem relativeEditDistance_comm :
    relativeEditDistance R₁ R₂ A = relativeEditDistance R₂ R₁ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [relativeEditDistance_eq, relativeEditDistance_eq, editDistance_comm]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_eq_count_div
statement:
theorem pairDensity_eq_count_div :
    pairDensity R A B = (pairCount R A B : ℝ) / (((A.card) : ℝ) * B.card)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity, densityOn, pairCount, Finset.card_product, Nat.cast_mul]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_nonneg
statement: theorem pairDensity_nonneg : 0 ≤ pairDensity R A B
proof: := densityOn_nonneg

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_le_one
statement: theorem pairDensity_le_one : pairDensity R A B ≤ 1
proof: := densityOn_le_one

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul :
    (pairCount R A B : ℝ) = pairDensity R A B * (((A.card) : ℝ) * B.card)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (((A.card) : ℝ) * B.card) 0 with hm | hm
  · rw [hm, mul_zero]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hm with h | h
    · rw [pairCount, Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast h : A.card = 0)]
      simp
    · rw [pairCount, Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast h : B.card = 0)]
      simp
  · rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact hm

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_card_biUnion_cast
statement:
theorem sum_card_biUnion_cast [DecidableEq α] {C : Finset α} (sC : Finset (Finset α))
    (hdisj : (sC : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hcover : sC.biUnion id = C) :
    (∑ C' ∈ sC, (C'.card : ℝ)) = (C.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (sC.biUnion id).card = ∑ C' ∈ sC, (id C').card :=
    Finset.card_biUnion fun x hx y hy hne => hdisj hx hy hne
  rw [hcover] at h
  simp only [id_eq] at h
  rw [h, Nat.cast_sum]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_biUnion
statement:
theorem pairCount_biUnion [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (R : α → β → Prop)
    [DecidableRel R] {C : Finset α} {D : Finset β}
    (sC : Finset (Finset α)) (sD : Finset (Finset β))
    (hCdisj : (sC : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hCcover : sC.biUnion id = C)
    (hDdisj : (sD : Set (Finset β)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hDcover : sD.biUnion id = D) :
    pairCount R C D = ∑ p ∈ sC ×ˢ sD, pairCount R p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hset : (C ×ˢ D).filter (fun q => R q.1 q.2)
      = (sC ×ˢ sD).biUnion (fun p => (p.1 ×ˢ p.2).filter (fun q => R q.1 q.2)) := by
    ext q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_biUnion, Prod.exists]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hq1, hq2⟩, hR⟩
      rw [← hCcover, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hq1
      rw [← hDcover, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hq2
      obtain ⟨C', hC', hq1'⟩ := hq1
      obtain ⟨D', hD', hq2'⟩ := hq2
      simp only [id_eq] at hq1' hq2'
      exact ⟨C', D', ⟨hC', hD'⟩, ⟨hq1', hq2'⟩, hR⟩
    · rintro ⟨C', D', ⟨hC', hD'⟩, ⟨hq1, hq2⟩, hR⟩
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hR⟩
      · rw [← hCcover, Finset.mem_biUnion]; exact ⟨C', hC', by simpa using hq1⟩
      · rw [← hDcover, Finset.mem_biUnion]; exact ⟨D', hD', by simpa using hq2⟩
  have hdisj : ∀ p ∈ sC ×ˢ sD, ∀ p' ∈ sC ×ˢ sD, p ≠ p' →
      Disjoint ((p.1 ×ˢ p.2).filter (fun q => R q.1 q.2))
        ((p'.1 ×ˢ p'.2).filter (fun q => R q.1 q.2)) := by
    intro p hp p' hp' hne
    rw [Finset.mem_product] at hp hp'
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy hxy'
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hxy hxy'
    by_cases hC : p.1 = p'.1
    · have hD : p.2 ≠ p'.2 := fun h => hne (Prod.ext hC h)
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hDdisj hp.2 hp'.2 hD)) hxy.1.2 hxy'.1.2
    · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hCdisj hp.1 hp'.1 hC)) hxy.1.1 hxy'.1.1
  unfold pairCount
  rw [hset, Finset.card_biUnion hdisj]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_mono
statement:
theorem pairCount_mono (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) :
    pairCount R A' B' ≤ pairCount R A B
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card
    (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.product_subset_product hA hB))

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_le_add
statement:
theorem pairCount_le_add :
    pairCount R A B
      ≤ pairCount R A' B' + (A \ A').card * B.card + A.card * (B \ B').card
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : (A ×ˢ B).filter (fun p => R p.1 p.2)
      ⊆ ((A' ×ˢ B').filter (fun p => R p.1 p.2) ∪ (A \ A') ×ˢ B) ∪ A ×ˢ (B \ B') := by
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hxy
    obtain ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, hR⟩ := hxy
    by_cases hxA' : x ∈ A'
    · by_cases hyB' : y ∈ B'
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
          (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hxA', hyB'⟩, hR⟩))
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _
          (Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hx, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hy, hyB'⟩⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx, hxA'⟩, hy⟩))
  refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.card_union_le _ _) ?_
  refine Nat.add_le_add ?_ (le_of_eq (Finset.card_product _ _))
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_union_le _ _)
    (Nat.add_le_add_left (le_of_eq (Finset.card_product _ _)) _)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_mul_le (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) :
    |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
      ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B \ B').card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcA : ((A \ A').card : ℝ) = (A.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hA, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hA)]
  have hcB : ((B \ B').card : ℝ) = (B.card : ℝ) - (B'.card : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hB, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hB)]
  have haa : (A'.card : ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card hA)
  have hbb : (B'.card : ℝ) ≤ (B.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card hB)
  have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hgap : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hstrip : (A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((A.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ)) * (B.card : ℝ)
        + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B.card : ℝ) - (B'.card : ℝ)) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr haa) (sub_nonneg.mpr hbb)]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (mul_nonneg ha0 hb0) with hm | hm
  · rw [← hm, mul_zero, hcA, hcB]
    linarith
  · have hmne : ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm
    have habs : |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
        = |(pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B) * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hm]
    have hprod : (pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B) * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
        = (pairCount R A' B' : ℝ)
          - pairDensity R A B * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) := by
      rw [sub_mul, pairDensity_eq_count_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hmne]
    rw [habs, hprod, abs_sub_le_iff]
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ pairDensity R A B := pairDensity_nonneg
    have hd1 : pairDensity R A B ≤ 1 := pairDensity_le_one
    have hNle : (pairCount R A' B' : ℝ) ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (pairCount_mono hA hB)
    have hN : (pairCount R A B : ℝ) = pairDensity R A B * ((A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ)) :=
      pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul
    have hadd : (pairCount R A B : ℝ)
        ≤ (pairCount R A' B' : ℝ) + ((A \ A').card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ)
          + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B \ B').card : ℝ) := by
      have := pairCount_le_add (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) (A' := A') (B' := B')
      exact_mod_cast this
    
    have hmass : pairDensity R A B * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
        ≤ pairDensity R A B * ((A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hd0
    
    have hweighted : pairDensity R A B
          * ((A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
        ≤ ((A.card : ℝ) - (A'.card : ℝ)) * (B.card : ℝ)
          + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B.card : ℝ) - (B'.card : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith
    rw [hcA, hcB] at hadd ⊢
    constructor
    · nlinarith
    · linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_le_of_pairDensity_le
statement:
theorem pairCount_le_of_pairDensity_le {c : ℝ} (h : pairDensity R A B ≤ c) :
    (pairCount R A B : ℝ) ≤ c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul,
    show c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card = c * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) from by ring]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity)

name: RegularityLemmata.le_pairCount_of_le_pairDensity
statement:
theorem le_pairCount_of_le_pairDensity {c : ℝ} (h : c ≤ pairDensity R A B) :
    c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul,
    show c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card = c * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) from by ring]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_sum_left
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_sum_left :
    pairCount R A B = ∑ x ∈ A, (B.filter fun y => R x y).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_sum_right
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_sum_right :
    pairCount R A B = ∑ y ∈ B, (A.filter fun x => R x y).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product_right]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_singleton_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_singleton_right (y : β) :
    pairCount R A {y} = (A.filter fun x => R x y).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount_eq_sum_right, Finset.sum_singleton]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_singleton_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_singleton_left (x : α) :
    pairCount R {x} B = (B.filter fun y => R x y).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount_eq_sum_left, Finset.sum_singleton]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_singleton_right
statement:
theorem pairDensity_singleton_right (y : β) :
    pairDensity R A {y} = ((A.filter fun x => R x y).card : ℝ) / A.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairCount_singleton_right]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_singleton_left
statement:
theorem pairDensity_singleton_left (x : α) :
    pairDensity R {x} B = ((B.filter fun y => R x y).card : ℝ) / B.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairCount_singleton_left]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_congr
statement:
theorem pairCount_congr {S : α → β → Prop} [DecidableRel S]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, (R x y ↔ S x y)) : pairCount R A B = pairCount S A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount, pairCount]
  refine congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr ?_)
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hp
  rw [Finset.mem_product] at hp
  exact h x hp.1 y hp.2

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_congr
statement:
theorem pairDensity_congr {S : α → β → Prop} [DecidableRel S]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, (R x y ↔ S x y)) : pairDensity R A B = pairDensity S A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairCount_congr h]

name: RegularityLemmata.swapRel_swapRel
statement: @[simp] theorem swapRel_swapRel (R : α → β → Prop) : swapRel (swapRel R) = R
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_swapRel
statement:
theorem pairCount_swapRel (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    pairCount (swapRel R) B A = pairCount R A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount, pairCount]
  refine Finset.card_bij' (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1)) (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1))
    (fun p hp => ?_) (fun p hp => ?_) (fun p _ => rfl) (fun p _ => rfl)
  · rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2⟩
  · rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_swapRel
statement:
theorem pairDensity_swapRel (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    pairDensity (swapRel R) B A = pairDensity R A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairCount_swapRel]
  ring

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_add_not
statement:
theorem pairCount_add_not :
    pairCount R A B + pairCount (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = A.card * B.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [pairCount, pairCount, ← Finset.card_product]
  exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (p := fun p : α × β => R p.1 p.2)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_empty_left (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (B : Finset β) :
    pairCount R ∅ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_empty_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_empty_right (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (A : Finset α) :
    pairCount R A ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCount]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairDensity_empty_left (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (B : Finset β) :
    pairDensity R ∅ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_empty_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairDensity_empty_right (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (A : Finset α) :
    pairDensity R A ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_add_not
statement:
theorem pairDensity_add_not (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    pairDensity R A B + pairDensity (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hAc : (0 : ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hA
  have hBc : (0 : ℝ) < (B.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hB
  have hm : ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, pairDensity_eq_count_div, ← add_div,
    div_eq_one_iff_eq hm, ← Nat.cast_add, pairCount_add_not, Nat.cast_mul]

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_not
statement:
theorem pairDensity_not (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    pairDensity (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = 1 - pairDensity R A B
proof:
:= by
  have h := pairDensity_add_not (R := R) hA hB
  linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_le_of_forall_singleton_le
statement:
theorem pairDensity_le_of_forall_singleton_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ B, pairDensity R A {y} ≤ c) : pairDensity R A B ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : (pairCount R A B : ℝ) ≤ c * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) := by
    rw [pairCount_eq_sum_right, Nat.cast_sum]
    have hcol : ∀ y ∈ B, ((A.filter fun x => R x y).card : ℝ) ≤ c * (A.card : ℝ) := by
      intro y hy
      have hle := pairCount_le_of_pairDensity_le (h y hy)
      rw [pairCount_singleton_right] at hle
      simpa using hle
    calc ∑ y ∈ B, ((A.filter fun x => R x y).card : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ _y ∈ B, c * (A.card : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hcol
      _ = c * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * B.card) with hm | hm
  · rw [← hm, div_zero]
    exact hc
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hm]
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.le_pairDensity_of_forall_le_singleton
statement:
theorem le_pairDensity_of_forall_le_singleton {c : ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ B, c ≤ pairDensity R A {y}) : c ≤ pairDensity R A B
proof:
:= by
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hA | hA
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hB
    have hy0 := h y hy
    rw [hA, pairDensity_empty_left] at hy0
    rw [hA, pairDensity_empty_left]
    exact hy0
  · have hcount : c * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ) := by
      rw [pairCount_eq_sum_right, Nat.cast_sum]
      have hcol : ∀ y ∈ B, c * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ ((A.filter fun x => R x y).card : ℝ) := by
        intro y hy
        have hle := le_pairCount_of_le_pairDensity (h y hy)
        rw [pairCount_singleton_right] at hle
        simpa using hle
      calc c * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card)
          = ∑ _y ∈ B, c * (A.card : ℝ) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
        _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ B, ((A.filter fun x => R x y).card : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hcol
    have hApos : (0 : ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hA
    have hBpos : (0 : ℝ) < (B.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hB
    rw [pairDensity_eq_count_div, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    linarith

name: RegularityLemmata.internalToTree_val
statement: @[simp] theorem internalToTree_val (x : InternalNode h) : (internalToTree x).1 = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.leafToTree_val
statement: @[simp] theorem leafToTree_val (x : LeafNode h) : (leafToTree x).1 = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.branchBelow_def
statement:
theorem branchBelow_def (b : Bool) (x y : List Bool) :
    BranchBelow b x y ↔ x ++ [b] <+: y
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.BranchBelow.isStrictPrefix
statement:
theorem BranchBelow.isStrictPrefix {b : Bool} {x y : List Bool} (h : BranchBelow b x y) :
    IsStrictPrefix x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(List.prefix_append _ _).trans h, ?_⟩
  intro hxy
  have := h.length_le
  simp [hxy] at this

name: RegularityLemmata.BranchBelow.length_lt
statement:
theorem BranchBelow.length_lt {b : Bool} {x y : List Bool} (h : BranchBelow b x y) :
    x.length < y.length
proof:
:= by
  have := h.length_le
  simp at this
  omega

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_branchBelow_of_isStrictPrefix
statement:
theorem exists_branchBelow_of_isStrictPrefix {x y : List Bool} (h : IsStrictPrefix x y) :
    ∃ b : Bool, BranchBelow b x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ := h
  cases t with
  | nil => exact (hne (by simpa using ht)).elim
  | cons b r => exact ⟨b, ⟨r, by simpa using ht⟩⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.eq_of_prefix_of_prefix_of_length_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_prefix_of_prefix_of_length_eq {l₁ l₂ l : List Bool}
    (h₁ : l₁ <+: l) (h₂ : l₂ <+: l) (hlen : l₁.length = l₂.length) : l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le h₁ h₂ (le_of_eq hlen)
  have htnil : t = [] := by
    have := congrArg List.length ht
    simp at this
    exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
  simpa [htnil] using ht

name: RegularityLemmata.not_branchBelow_of_branchBelow
statement:
theorem not_branchBelow_of_branchBelow {b : Bool} {x y : List Bool}
    (h₁ : BranchBelow b x y) (h₂ : BranchBelow (!b) x y) : False
proof:
:= by
  have := eq_of_prefix_of_prefix_of_length_eq h₁ h₂ (by simp)
  have hb : b = !b := by simpa using congrArg (fun l => l.getLast?) this
  cases b <;> simp at hb

name: RegularityLemmata.prefix_trichotomy
statement:
theorem prefix_trichotomy : ∀ x y : List Bool,
    x <+: y ∨ y <+: x ∨ ∃ (z : List Bool) (b : Bool), BranchBelow b z x ∧ BranchBelow (!b) z y
proof:
| [], _ => Or.inl List.nil_prefix
  | _ :: _, [] => Or.inr (Or.inl List.nil_prefix)
  | a :: x, c :: y => by
      by_cases hac : a = c
      · subst hac
        rcases prefix_trichotomy x y with hp | hp | ⟨z, b, h1, h2⟩
        · exact Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, hp⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, hp⟩))
        · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a :: z, b, ?_, ?_⟩)
          · rw [BranchBelow, List.cons_append]
            exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, h1⟩
          · rw [BranchBelow, List.cons_append]
            exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, h2⟩
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨[], a, ?_, ?_⟩)
        · rw [BranchBelow, List.nil_append]
          exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, List.nil_prefix⟩
        · have hb : (!a) = c := by cases a <;> cases c <;> simp_all
          rw [BranchBelow, List.nil_append]
          exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨hb, List.nil_prefix⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.root_val
statement: @[simp] theorem root_val (h : ℕ) : (root h).1 = []
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.child_val
statement: @[simp] theorem child_val (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode h) : (child b x).1 = x.1 ++ [b]
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.branchBelow_child
statement:
theorem branchBelow_child (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode h) :
    BranchBelow b x.1 (child b x).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [BranchBelow, child_val]

name: RegularityLemmata.parent_val
statement: @[simp] theorem parent_val (x : TreeNode h) : (parent x).1 = x.1.dropLast
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.consInternal_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem consInternal_val (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode h) :
    (consInternal b x).1 = b :: x.1
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.branchBelow_root_cons
statement:
theorem branchBelow_root_cons (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode h) :
    BranchBelow b (root h).1 (consInternal b x).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [BranchBelow, root_val, List.nil_append, consInternal_val]
  exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, List.nil_prefix⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.consInternal_injective
statement:
theorem consInternal_injective (b : Bool) :
    Function.Injective (consInternal (h := h) b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  exact Subtype.ext (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hxy)

name: RegularityLemmata.internalNode_cases
statement:
theorem internalNode_cases (x : InternalNode (h + 1)) :
    x = root h ∨ ∃ (b : Bool) (y : InternalNode h), x = consInternal b y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := x
  cases w with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons b w => exact Or.inr ⟨b, ⟨w, by simpa using hw⟩, rfl⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_wordsLE
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_wordsLE : ∀ {h : ℕ} {w : List Bool}, w ∈ wordsLE h ↔ w.length ≤ h
proof:
| 0, _ => by simp [wordsLE, List.length_eq_zero_iff]
  | _ + 1, [] => by simp [wordsLE]
  | h + 1, b :: w => by
      simp [wordsLE, mem_wordsLE (h := h)]
      cases b <;> simp

name: RegularityLemmata.leafNode_zero_eq
statement: theorem leafNode_zero_eq (x : LeafNode 0) : x = ⟨[], rfl⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero x.2)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_leafNode
statement: @[simp] theorem card_leafNode (h : ℕ) : Fintype.card (LeafNode h) = 2 ^ h
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (LeafNode h)
      = @Fintype.card (List.Vector Bool h) (List.Vector.instFintype) :=
    Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.refl _)
  rw [hcard, card_vector]
  simp

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteBox.mem_tuples
statement:
@[simp] theorem FiniteBox.mem_tuples [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : FiniteBox V}
    {x : ∀ i, V i} : x ∈ A.tuples ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ A i
proof:
:=
  Fintype.mem_piFinset

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteBox.reindex_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem FiniteBox.reindex_apply {ι' : Type*} (e : ι' ≃ ι) (A : FiniteBox V) (j : ι') :
    A.reindex e j = A (e j)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleWeight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tupleWeight_apply [Fintype ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    tupleWeight w x = ∏ i, w i (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_apply
statement:
theorem boxMass_apply [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass w A = ∑ x ∈ A.tuples, tupleWeight w x
proof: := rfl

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass
statement:
theorem boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxMass w A = ∏ i, finsetMass (w i) (A i)
proof:
:=
  (Finset.prod_univ_sum A w).symm

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_one
statement:
theorem boxMass_one [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass (fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) A = ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => finsetMass_one (A i)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem boxMass_nonneg [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    (hw : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ A i, 0 ≤ w i v) : 0 ≤ boxMass w A
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass]
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => finsetMass_nonneg (hw i)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_mono
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass, boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass]
  refine Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => ?_) (fun i _ => ?_)
  · exact finsetMass_nonneg fun v hv => hw i v (hAB i hv)
  · exact finsetMass_mono (hw i) (hAB i)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_of_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxMass_of_eq_empty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    {A : FiniteBox V} {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) : boxMass w A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass]
  refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) ?_
  rw [hi, finsetMass_empty]

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxMass_of_isEmpty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [IsEmpty ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxMass w A = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass, Finset.prod_of_isEmpty]

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_reindex
statement:
